programme.title: 金厲害潛水艇
programme.desc: 年輕天真的海豚金厲害帶領一艘裝滿魚兒和海水的另類潛水艇，打算前往他們夢寐以求,具有純淨水源的陸地拉斯維加斯，但這段奇葩的海陸大冒險沿途總是波折不斷，有時內憂有時外患,一點也不平靜

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片

programme.title: 恐龍邦尼的世界
programme.desc: 在一起進行的有趣且富有想像的冒險中，邦尼幫助孩子們探索學齡前的強烈情緒，並向他們展示如何愛自己愛他人以及社區

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程
programme.desc: 兔巴哥大工程由兔巴哥和蘿拉經營的樂樂工程隊，或許施工品質可能有點令人擔憂，但笑料絕對是貨真價實的！鎖定卡通頻道以免錯過任何精彩笑料！

programme.title: 農場雞動隊
programme.desc: 最不像英雄的英雄小隊農場雞動隊 總是在動物們有危難時跳出來神救援小隊由四隻農場動物外加一顆蛋所組成，他們渴望藉由冒險救援跳脫平凡的農場生活，因此每天總是衝鋒陷陣到處幫忙！

programme.title: 超級蝙蝠車第1季
programme.desc: 當蝙蝠俠羅賓和蝙蝠女孩的車輛都有了生命，高譚市出現了一支年輕的打擊犯罪隊伍，他們已經迫不及待要展開冒險了！

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠
programme.desc: 家了來三隻可惡的小貓，弄得家裡天翻地覆，還害得湯姆一直被主人誤會，不僅如此，連傑利也被整了，氣得湯姆與傑利攜手合作，共同對抗這三隻可惡的狠角色！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go

programme.desc: 豆豆先生帶著相機想要捕捉大自然的美態，可是反被大自然捕捉的他感到非常糗也非常生氣!原來是受到野生動物紀錄片的啟發，豆豆先生拿起他塵封已久的老相機出發到郊外想要捕捉完美的野生動物照片,不過瞎忙了兩天卻一點收獲也沒有,最後還發現自己竟然才是被捕捉的對象！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go
programme.desc: 少年悍將！GO是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目也是DC系列少年悍將漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現

programme.title: 怪盜喬克
programme.desc: 主人公的怪盜JOKER與助手小八一起，不僅要從警察妨礙中逃出生天，還要與怪盜斯佩德女怪盜鑽石女王鬥智鬥勇下，一次次將寶物成功盜走

programme.title: 超級小白:41
programme.desc: 野原小白，一隻看起來不能再平凡的小狗其實是隻超能狗平日就在維持和平的小白在帶上超能S章後就會自信爆棚他，只有一個目標，就是保護傳說中的Bobobobobone，聽說誰得到它就能統治世界

programme.title: 農場雞動隊
programme.desc: 最不像英雄的英雄小隊農場雞動隊 總是在動物們有危難時跳出來神救援小隊由四隻農場動物外加一顆蛋所組成，他們渴望藉由冒險救援跳脫平凡的農場生活，因此每天總是衝鋒陷陣到處幫忙！

programme.title: 難捕
programme.desc: 從實驗室裡逃脫的黏TT橙色生物！可是身為偽裝界變身達人的難捕就像他的名字一樣難捕! 哪有那麼簡單就被捉回去!看來這兩位瘋狂科學家的日子只會更加失控!更加混亂!

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝
programme.desc: 一個超酷的寶寶樂團，即便受到討厭音樂的托兒所保母密切監督，這些音樂控寶貝們仍持續他們充滿歡樂與節奏的冒險， 快和娃娃飛仔 米呦卡羅斯與他們快抓狂的保母朵朵開一起隨著音樂大力搖擺！

programme.title: 天兵公園-追憶錄影帶
programme.desc: 明明是簡單的工作卻引爆超現實又荒誕的災難! 反正只要有鳥哥和阿天在的地方，不管大事小事普通事都會變成令人難以置信的大混亂，當然也包括惹火老闆及同事給自己找麻煩

programme.title: 轉角那間心藥局
programme.desc: 轉角，有一間心藥局在這片親手打造的空間裡，凝聚著幾位志同道合的夥伴，為社區中孤單無助或與病痛對抗的人，提供支持與陪伴這家藥局，不僅僅是買藥取藥的地方每張處方背後，都藏著一段故事一份關心他們用專業照顧身體，也用心守護 每一位來訪者的情緒與需要這不只是一份工作，更是一場關於心與療癒的修行

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版
programme.desc: 風月同天此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫共度風雨影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影以行動，讓愛無國界這，就是慈濟一個由無數人的小善匯聚成世界之光的故事

programme.title: 仁心慧語
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實證嚴 上人說：做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴十個問題十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值

programme.title: 快樂小蘑菇

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場
programme.desc: 1945年，村岡花子邊看原文小說，邊翻查著字典，將譯文撰寫於稿紙上這一年她已經52歲，正在進行小說Anne of Green Gables的翻譯工作此時正值二次大戰末期，節節敗退的日本正遭受盟軍轟炸機的密集轟炸，因此花子在工作時，還得隨時注意外頭的狀況，若發布空襲警報，就得帶著女兒到防空洞避難每當避難時，她手上必定帶著書本及譯稿，對花子來說，這是比她的生命還重要的東西這天她一如往常的進行翻譯工作，她突然停下了筆，開始回想她這一生的經歷，花子與安妮的故事就此展開

極限逃殺
programme.desc: 懸崖上的生死對決，她將如何死裡逃生？！熱愛攀岩的凱莉，意外目睹閨蜜蘇菲慘遭四名男子殺害，為了躲避他們的追殺，她被迫在無人救援的深夜，徒手攀上陡峭的懸崖面對後有瘋狂歹徒緊追，前有絕命深淵的極限困局，凱莉必須在體力透支的邊緣與歹徒展開高空對決，試圖在恐懼中殺出一條生路！

programme.title: 戰馬一號
programme.desc: 面對恐怖攻擊，他以寡擊眾，誓死守護！繼驚天營救之後，另一項艱鉅任務為了拯救從阿富汗撤離的美國傳教士家庭，美軍派出代號戰馬的小隊前往，誰知軍機慘遭塔利班叛軍擊落，除了米爾科士官長之外，其他士兵全數罹難，倖存者米爾科決定繼續救人任務，當他找到傳教士一家人時，發現僅有小女兒佐伊倖存，隨後他帶著佐伊躲避叛軍追殺，面對敵軍層層包圍，他是否可以完成任務呢？！

programme.title: 紅雀
programme.desc: 為了照料病重的母親，身為芭蕾舞名伶的她，決定化身冷血女間諜多明妮卡因舞伴失誤受傷，無法繼續跳舞，這時，擔任SVR副局長的叔叔伊凡，推薦她進入情報系統為了讓母親得到良好的醫療照顧，多明妮卡接受國家嚴厲訓練，成為組織內最頂尖的紅雀，而她的首要任務就是利用美色向美國中央情報局特務奈特套出情報；而這時，奈特也在上級指示下，設法深入俄國情治單位

programme.title: 限制級褓母
programme.desc: 美國特種部隊軍人蕭沃虎馮迪索飾演驍勇 善戰，是不可多得的軍事天才，一天他被上級指派前往臥底保護一位重要科學家普拉默的家以及他的五個寶貝孩子，同時起出科學家普拉 默暗藏在住家裡的秘密發明但是他萬萬沒想 到，自己竟然成了五個小孩的臨時保母 普拉默一家五個孩子三男二女，從叛逆青少年 到還在包尿布的年齡都有，蕭沃虎拿出自己多年累積的軍事訓練成果來對付他生命中最困難的一項任務 五個孩子也拿出自己的看家本領將臨時保母蕭沃虎搞的七暈八素，更別提普拉 默家的寵物鴨蓋瑞，更是對蕭沃虎充滿了敵意蕭沃虎發現自己所受的軍事訓練完全派不 上用場，於是他開始採用愛的教育

programme.title: 特種部隊-眼鏡蛇的崛起
programme.desc: 邪惡勢力悄然崛起，世界陷入全面癱瘓危機，頂尖菁英正面迎戰神秘組織眼鏡蛇企圖用奈米蟲吞噬地表，特種部隊為此穿上超能戰甲迎戰，從巴黎鐵塔的極速追逐到北極冰原的終極決戰除了雷射與核武的威脅，黑白兩大蒙面忍者蛇眼與白幽靈更展開宿命的刀劍對決，這一次，勝負將決定人類的命運！

programme.title: 特種精英
programme.desc: 本片由暢銷小說改編而成杭特與丹尼是殺手，也是生死之交在某次任務中，丹尼因無法向小孩開槍，毅然退出行列，直到杭特慘遭老酋長囚禁原來杭特受雇老酉長以600萬美金代價，暗殺當年殺害他三名兒子的兇手，但兇手個個身手不凡，杭特因而未能完成為了營救杭特，丹尼私自組隊，不惜鋌而走險，但任務困難重重，因為每個暗殺，都必須像意外致死一般

programme.title: 絕命塔羅牌

programme.title: 八肢的藝術

programme.title: 北方人

programme.title: 一字千金:23
programme.desc: 字是一種文化的保存和演進，代表著人與人間的溝通及資訊的傳遞而繁體字是中華文化最燦爛的瑰寶之一！無論在字意的表達以及字形的美觀上都有著非常高的價值中文的美造字的藝術背後的含意，不是英文字母不是圓圈線條構成的文字所能比擬的為了提高當下電視節目的內容深度，為了關注青少年對國字知識與文化傳統的認知，為了重新燃起民眾對於國字的情感，同時也為青少年建造一個文化傳承的轉捩點，在益智遊戲競賽的架構下，一字千金期許能夠帶動正當社會風潮，重新將繁體國字發揚光大，再創中華文化新亮點

programme.desc: 擅長蛇毒研究的荷蘭生物學家弗里克．馮克（Freek Vonk），以豐富的知識以及無窮的活力成為荷蘭最受歡迎的節目主持人，他喜歡在節目中上天下海翻山越嶺，探訪各種動物的棲息地，分享他對大自然界的熱愛在海陸空極限大搜查中他將帶領大家走訪烏干達的茂密雨林巴西的遼闊濕地印尼與馬來西亞的熱帶島嶼，以及墨西哥的神祕洞穴，展開壯烈的跨國生態大冒險

programme.title: 狗狗幫大忙:1
programme.desc: 本系列是根據真實個案發展，每一集都是狗狗幫助主人的溫馨小故事系列中出現的工作犬有導盲犬黃金拉不拉多基卡；可卡犬迪索是主人的導聽犬，協助辨別生活中的警訊聲邊境牧羊犬梅姬是會進行搜索與救援的搜救犬，紐芬蘭犬希爾維是治療犬，專門幫助人類舒緩情緒；拉薩犬汀克斯是協助犬，協助身障主人處理生活中的障礙讓我們跟著訓練有素且充滿愛心的工作犬基卡迪索梅姬希爾維和汀克斯，看看牠們如何運用狗狗超能力，為主人完成重要任務

programme.title: 一字千金:24
programme.desc: 字是一種文化的保存和演進，代表著人與人間的溝通及資訊的傳遞而繁體字是中華文化最燦爛的瑰寶之一！無論在字意的表達以及字形的美觀上都有著非常高的價值中文的美造字的藝術背後的含意，不是英文字母不是圓圈線條構成的文字所能比擬的為了提高當下電視節目的內容深度，為了關注青少年對國字知識與文化傳統的認知，為了重新燃起民眾對於國字的情感，同時也為青少年建造一個文化傳承的轉捩點，在益智遊戲競賽的架構下，一字千金期許能夠帶動正當社會風潮，重新將繁體國字發揚光大，再創中華文化新亮點

programme.title: 動物吃播秀
programme.desc: 動物開飯食堂，開課了！動物版的美食地圖，是什麼呢？生氣勃勃的地球，既有各類植物，也有以植物為食的動物，還有捕食這些動物的掠食者，有些動物能輕鬆享用盛宴，而有些則不停奔忙找食物不斷變化的覓食學習，是地球上的生物們的必經之旅，人類的食譜包羅萬象，但在飲食上卻能挑剔地選擇多樣，超市的存在與食物供應，讓我們容易忘記，所有的食物其實都源自於大自然人類不得不重新回到食物課堂，去學習生存之道

programme.title: 末日之戰

programme.title: 鬼天廈
programme.desc: 事靈感來自台灣知名的猛鬼大廈之一的兇宅，這棟位在台北市中心的大廈，曾在30 多年內發生超過20 多件命案，讓此棟的房價比周圍的其他建案都便宜許多 其中，最著名的事件便是在80 年代的一場火災，造成300 多人受困，最後奪走19 條人命

programme.title: 國產凌凌漆
programme.desc: 大陸國寶恐龍頭骨遭到神秘金鎗客所竊司令派出閒置十年不用的情報員凌凌漆周星馳到香港追查此案，同時也派手下李香琴袁詠儀殺凌漆香琴起初對漆充滿敵意，但在相處之後開始對司令的命令產生懷疑

programme.title: 拆彈專家2
programme.desc: 香港發生連環爆炸案，令全城人心惶惶前拆彈專家潘乘風（劉德華飾）昏迷於案發現場，被警方列為頭號嫌疑犯，懷疑他跟邪惡組織復生會有密切聯繫甦醒後的潘乘風，面對警方施壓式的盤問和牢獄之災，決定逃走親自查明真相在孤立無援的絕路上，潘乘風找他的戰友拆彈專家董卓文（劉青雲飾）協助，但由於二人陷入黑白不明的矛盾狀況，董卓文必須在公私之間作出抉擇基於出生入死的友情，他決定向摯友伸出援手同時，潘乘風前女友龐玲（倪妮飾），現為反恐特勤隊總督察，急於查出連環爆炸案的幕後黑手，以確保市民安全，她說服潘乘風接觸復生會，追查這神秘組織的下一步恐襲計劃，以證明他的清白然而，令潘乘風最意想不到的, 竟是揭破真相就如拆除炸彈般危險艱鉅，在爭分奪秒中隨時送命

programme.title: 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 因緣際會，玄奘無意間解開了五行山下鎮壓孫悟空的佛印孫悟空受制於觀音菩薩所賜的金箍，應下保護唐僧西去的使命悟空雖然心中不服玄奘，但他一路上開山問路，收服八戒沙僧，倒也盡忠職守然而，頭頂的金箍與唐僧制約他的緊箍咒法卻始終困擾著他白虎嶺白骨夫人千年成精，必須服用玄奘金身方可擺脫妖物輪回大限白骨精洞悉孫悟空與唐僧之間的隔閡，故而三番兩次挑撥二人師徒關係孫悟空在背負屈辱之下，還要以武鬥以智取難奈玄奘凡胎肉眼，看不清白骨真身白骨詭計得逞，師徒二人就此決裂

programme.title: 談判專家
programme.desc: 談判專家卓文偉意外成為命案的頭號嫌犯，導致他在無奈之下挾持了警局，並要求前談判專家謝家俊出面與自己對質

programme.title: 海角七號
programme.desc: 1945年第二次世界大戰結束後，臺灣的日治時代終結，進入中華民國時代，日本人被全數遣返回日本本土12月，一位日本籍教師在高砂丸遣返船上，一字一句寫下給他臺灣籍女學生兼愛人小島友子的七封情書信封上簡單寫著台?恒春郡海角七番地小島友子?，但隨著兩人分離兩地另組家庭，成了寄不出去的七封情書

programme.title: 航海王:1107
programme.desc: 偉大航路的黃金梅利號阿拉巴斯坦的王女．薇薇也在船上被稱為沙漠之國的阿拉巴斯坦王國，從以前就一直被不降雨的異常氣像所困擾，為人民著想的國王．寇布拉身邊，人人和平的生活著但是距今兩年前，雨變得只落在國王所居住的城市裡，同時間，世界政府禁止製造持有的人工降雨粉．跳舞粉也運往國王的身邊這事件成為國王與人民分裂的開端相信身為父親也是國王．寇布拉的薇薇，為了要把引起這異常氣像並陷害國王的邪惡組織的身分曝光而離開她的國家而現在為了阻止萬惡根源卻是國家英雄的克洛克達爾，薇薇和魯夫等夥伴一同前往阿拉巴斯坦為了奪回被奪走的重要東西而奔走！

programme.title: 焚城
programme.desc: 故事描述一場意外引發輻射洩漏，全港命運危在旦夕為應付這場毀滅性災難，專家范偉立（劉德華 飾）加入由代理特首Cecilia（莫文蔚 飾）主持的緊急危機應變小組香港700多萬人的家園可能隨時毀於一旦，消防隊臨危受命深入輻射區，拼死阻止輻射擴散全港面對前所未見的末日浩劫，香港能否免於一夜滅城？

programme.title: 阿飛與阿基
programme.desc: 阿飛和阿基是一對患難兄弟，從小一齊長大一塊混江湖，情義深重的生死之交阿飛與阿基天生命硬，他們追隨過的黑幫老大，都被他們剋死，所以街坊鄰居都不願與他們接近，而其它黑社會組織更不歡迎他們加入，因此他們想要起另起爐灶，合伙創立黑幫

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣:285
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的IPSS 的女王小S，睽違六年強勢回歸！ 以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 全民星攻略:285
programme.desc: 用智慧掌握機會才能創造獨一無二的命運 全民星攻略智慧星幣翻倍賽 不變的是廣度與深度的知識含量

programme.title: 今晚開讚吧:291
programme.desc: 結合不同族群社團粉絲團民調排行榜合作！ 利用大數據分析，反應市場趨勢，精準抓出熱門關注話題！

programme.title: 痞子英雄首部曲-全面開戰
programme.desc: 故事為電視版的前傳，設定於電視版的三年前，片尾結局將連接電視版第一集三年前的吳英雄，血氣方剛，在南區分局重案特勤組執勤，一辦案把整座城市鬧得天下大亂，被組長勒令外勤，卻固執追尋一宗離奇案件而城市的另一邊，最大黑幫三聯會的西岸堂口，年紀最大的三級幹部---徐達夫，挪用堂主的100萬現金偷偷去做鑽石買賣漆黑的貨櫃倉儲區，交易到手的達夫，突然遭受一支重裝隊伍亂槍掃射攻擊，混亂之中，循著線索來到現場的英雄就此碰上徐達夫...

programme.title: 鬼咬鬼2
programme.desc: 肥寶一天做了個夢，夢裡他與父母生前為他指腹為婚的朱家大小姐朱女私奔，誤闖鬼屋，還被惡鬼追殺後被師父九叔拍醒一夜肥寶賣粥遇見女鬼小紅，他同情小紅身世淒涼，故收留小紅母女一人一鬼住進家中

programme.title: 賭城風雲
programme.desc: 外號贏盡天下無敵手的石一堅，不單能摸出麻將點數，連撲克牌點數也能摸出來，他從美國賭城擔任保安總顧問退休回澳門老家，遇上當年好友Benz其兒子曬冷及外甥牛必勝，曬冷及牛必勝希望能跟這位傳奇人物拜師學藝，堅要曬冷騙倒他一次或贏他一次，才答應收為徒曬冷之同母異父兄長陳龍是臥底探員，一直潛伏於國際賭業犯罪組織，組織將全球外圍球賽博彩的黑幫聯合起來，操縱賽果，其開會過程被龍拍下，並將罪証內容藏於一隻假眼中，而這隻假眼輾轉落入堅的獨女彩虹手中，令原本退休的堅不得不再以魔術手佈下騙局解救危機

programme.title: 最佳損友闖情關
programme.desc: 三大損友之一咸濕超結婚當日, 其餘兩損友牛精帆臭口奇企圖阻撓, 而新娘Dorlina則成功逼超簽下賣身契, 令他流下第二滴淚貴之兄徐定富因公司經營不善而欠下霍氏巨債, 更被逼清盤貴為拯救其兄, 於是連同三損友混入霍氏, 從而展開對四眼蛇Niko的追求, 引起重重誤會

programme.title: 緊急迫降

programme.title: 雍正王朝
programme.desc: 西元1722年清康熙六十一年，康熙駕崩，舉國震驚繼位者不是當了近四十年太子的二阿哥，也不是深受康熙鍾愛的十四阿哥，而是素有冷面王之稱的四阿哥胤禎胤禎的皇位不是篡來的，更不是改遺詔或毒父奪來的，而是康熙傳授，選擇了胤禎當皇帝，自此，清朝進入了雍正王朝的時代

programme.title: 雍正王朝
programme.desc: 西元1722年清康熙六十一年，康熙駕崩，舉國震驚繼位者不是當了近四十年太子的二阿哥，也不是深受康熙鍾愛的十四阿哥，而是素有冷面王之稱的四阿哥胤禎胤禎的皇位不是篡來的，更不是改遺詔或毒父奪來的，而是康熙傳授，選擇了胤禎當皇帝，自此，清朝進入了雍正王朝的時代

programme.title: 宮
programme.desc: 現代女子兼古董店的繼承人洛晴川，在訂婚儀式上為了追一幅被風吹走的清裝美人圖而跑至一處神秘樹林中美人圖到手的一剎那卻腳下一空，跌入時空隧道並穿越到清朝康熙四十七年（即1708年），偶遇身在高位卻每日戰戰兢兢怕從高位上跌下來的太子胤礽，玩世不恭愛闖禍的八阿哥胤?，還有喜怒無常不相信任何人的四阿哥胤禛

programme.title: 亡命機劫
programme.desc: 以全世界客機劫持事件橫行的20世紀70年代為背景，講述1971年一架客機在韓國上空被劫持，機組人員與乘客們在極端狀況下展開殊死搏鬥的故事

programme.title: 夏日樂悠悠
programme.desc: 多年前，小女孩夏米的父母意外葬身大海，而自己則幸運地被漁夫大叔救回，自此她一直非常厭惡大海由於她有讀唇語的技能，被她律師樓的客戶點名要求她前往一個小島，調查島上旅館老闆游樂樂的非法詐騙行為

programme.title: 濟公之降龍降世
programme.desc: 為了讓久病纏身的娘病癒，頑童李修緣一心想成為英雄，其父受金翎蠱惑，卻被搶走金身，金翅大鵬因此提前復活毀滅人間，父子攜手肉身抵抗金翅大鵬，卻以卵擊石，瀕死的李修緣，頓悟比金身更重要的是愛，最終化身降龍羅漢，降龍羅漢放棄果位，從此，天上少了一名降龍羅漢，世間多了一個濟世救人的活佛

programme.title: 大顯神威
programme.desc: 保坪宮第十八代師公-王富貴，人稱豬哥仙，其實是個逢賭必輸的落魄師公沒想到遇見了美豔動人的阿飄晴霞，從此時來運轉，但好運總要付出代價的原來，晴霞當年是紅透半邊天的歌姬，為了愛香消玉殞，含冤遊蕩在陰陽兩界這次找上豬哥仙，要他大顯神威，解開謎底

programme.title: 尋龍訣
programme.desc: 盜墓高手胡八一（陳坤 飾）決定金盆洗手他與未婚妻Shirley楊（舒琪 飾）移居美國，婚禮前，發現二十年前死在百眼窟的初戀對象丁思甜（Angelababy 飾）居然還活著老胡決定聯手Shirley楊及老搭擋王凱旋（黃勃 飾）再度踏入千年古墓，卻發現流傳千年的驚天秘密

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-紺青之拳
programme.desc: 真相 vs 魔術 vs 蹴擊，一決雌雄的三位一體戰鬥懸疑劇！ 世界最大藍寶石紺青之拳，19世紀末隨海盜船沉沒在新加坡近海，當地富豪打撈上岸，而濱海灣金沙酒店的殺人案現場有怪盜基德染血的預告信小蘭與園子為了觀賞空手道錦標賽前往新加坡，沒有護照的柯南留守看家，不料被基德強行帶到新加坡若不服從基德，柯南無法回日本，只得配合變裝化名亞瑟平井

programme.title: 總舖師
programme.desc: 楊祐寧夏于喬林美秀吳念真柯一正聯合演出 20多年前，台灣辦桌界有三大傳奇總舖師稱霸北中南！分別為憨人師吳念真飾鬼頭師喜翔飾與蒼蠅師柯一正飾，鄉民們尊稱他們人鬼神三霸隨著時代變動，辦桌文化勢微，人鬼神凋零蒼蠅師想將家傳手藝交給獨生女詹小婉夏于喬飾，誰知小婉只想當明星，美美出現在螢光幕前但一心逃離油煙血水的小婉卻被迫面對巨大的挑戰和使命..... 原來想當明星的小婉的星途走的並不順遂，再加上遇上一個惡意留下債務給她揹的男友，於是只好跑路回家鄉；豈料自己的母親過的也不好，因為自蒼蠅師過世後，其弟子阿財師便接收所有的生意，而小婉母親的廚藝又不好，更是惹出麻煩，最後也落入跑路一途母女兩人便相依為命地開了一間小麵館，雖然生意因故而時好時壞，總是可以維持生計 有一天，一位來歷神秘的客人因故決定教小婉幾道辦桌的菜餚...

programme.title: 張三豐
programme.desc: 南宋末年，各方勢力風起雲湧，國家陷入內憂外患，狄族聯合魔教，妄圖踏平中原稱霸江湖，危難之際，無極派大弟子張君寶挺身而出，協助宋廷擊退敵軍，卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗為振興門派，保衛家園，張君寶毅然踏上了剷除魔教的道路，誰曾想，他又被捲入一場更大的陰謀之中

programme.title: 角頭-大橋頭
programme.desc: Michael哥（王陽明 飾）回來了，他跟天借膽 ，帶著瘋蠍子（張懷秋 飾）想拿下頂莊北城北館，在貴董（高捷 飾）哈達（太保 飾）勇桑（蔡振南 飾）的眼皮子底下賣藥，甚至想仗著自己幾分交情，拉攏勇桑的二把手清楓（孫鵬 飾），沒想到被打得灰頭土臉， 卻在這時，他看不上眼的土狗們阿猛（施名帥 飾）阿慶（鄭人碩 飾）宗保（張再興 飾），竟然能闖入仁哥（王識賢 飾）憨春（陳萬號 飾）的賭場，搶下巨款，還活著回來，讓他又驚又喜

programme.title: 查無此心
programme.desc: 一年前，第二分局偵查隊副隊長吳潔在賭場外守了一整夜，但到頭來一無所獲不久之後，她接到了心碎的消息：她的丈夫，同為隊裡的同仁，因憂鬱症在車內舉槍自盡遺書上寫著對不起！吳潔弄髒你的車...

programme.title: 寒單
programme.desc: 正月十五，夜晚的街頭鑼鼓喧天，炮炸寒單爺現場擠滿了人潮，肉身寒單阿義站在神轎上，威風凜凜地接受信徒丟上鞭炮轟炸忽然間，成堆的炸藥被引爆，震耳欲聾，尖叫聲不斷...... 意外造成阿義女友萱萱的死亡，不忍心看保住性命卻喪失一切的阿義墮落社會邊緣，正昆毅然放棄成為教師的機會挺身相助，用盡力氣將阿義拉離地獄的深淵歃血為盟的兄弟二人，一同經營昆儀回收場刻苦耐勞地生活著，卻怎知當年意外的真相曝光之後，從此兩人在情義的天平兩端生死掙扎，炸在身上的紋身之罪，是否能抵消深藏的錐心之痛？

programme.title: 霍元甲之精武天下
programme.desc: 清朝末年，八國聯軍入侵後，日軍趁機進駐天津開設武館，展開征服中國的第一步此舉激發了天津習武之人的愛國意識，一代宗師霍元甲將代表天津的武者們，接受日本武術的挑戰，守護鄉里眾人的尊嚴

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-紺青之拳

programme.title: 通天神探狄仁傑
programme.desc: 西元690年，武則天劉嘉玲飾 即將登基，成為中國第一位女皇帝象徵至高皇權的通天浮屠接近完工，路人皆知浮屠落成之日，女皇登基之時此時洛陽發生幾起命案，死者無故自燃，都在胸腹間起火，延及全身，宛若炮烙般被燒成灰燼，都是武則天的親信！

programme.title: 封神第一部-朝歌風雲
programme.desc: 商王殷壽（費翔 飾）與嬌豔的狐妖妲己（娜然 飾）交好，暴虐無道，將引發天譴，崑崙仙人姜子牙（黃渤 飾）遂攜封神榜下山，尋找天下共主以救蒼生曾視殷壽為明主的太子殷郊（陳牧馳 飾）以及西伯侯質子姬發（于適 飾）也漸漸發現殷壽的狠毒面目，決定反出朝歌各方勢力暗流湧動，朝歌即將風雲變色

programme.title: 行運超人
programme.desc: 葉孤紅（楊千嬅）自小霉運不斷，為了改運，她找上香港著名風水師賴料布（梁朝偉）料布與孤紅兩人投緣，但賴家確有祖宗遺訓禁止與葉姓人士接近，令料布不敢與孤紅更近一步經過孤紅的努力，料布終於決心突破心防接受孤紅此時料布發現原來孤紅的霉運是玄學高手斷蟹（鄭中基）的從中作梗

programme.title: 小孩不笨3
programme.desc: 小孩不笨3故事描述升學大敵當前，媽媽文婷（胡靜 飾）展開各式包贏攻略，逼著兒子梓豪（周俞辰 飾）念書，所有魔鬼補習方法接踵而來，完全不理會孩子是否承受得了梓豪靠著死背活背讓成績明顯進步，引起校內一直以來的學霸Jayden（江松恆 飾）的媽媽Sophia（柳勝美 飾）的注意，深怕兒子坐不上第一名的寶座

programme.title: 千王之王2000
programme.desc: 香港大老千法拉利（王晶飾）興風作浪，呼風喚雨，周旋於大亨巨賈中，每逢週末更在巨宅中大開派對，美女如雲，酒池肉林，吸引富豪來往，法拉利乘機出千詐賭，更偷拍富豪與美女的偷歡情景，恐嚇金錢...

programme.title: 乒乓男孩

programme.desc: 1911年辛亥革命終推翻滿清帝制，建立民國然而成功衹是短暫，幾年間風雲激盪中國再次陷入軍閥割據，南北分裂，自己人關門打自己人之局面風乘火勢，外國列強趁機爭佔地盤，設立租界，坐地分肥，更恥笑國人為東亞病夫當時之武術界仍不知為恥，各門各派，同床異夢，各自為政，衹顧爭領風騷，猶如一盤散沙

programme.title: 戇夫成龍:1
programme.desc: 事情緣起於傻仔丁常旺，旺本是豪門富商包慶豐九代單傳的獨子，旺母本是包老爺的妾侍，因原配夫人妒忌，誣捏旺母與家樸有染，包老爺盛怒之下，視有了身孕的旺母是懷有孽種，把旺母逐出家門，旺母流落異鄉並誕下旺，兩母子過了二十幾年相依為命的艱苦生活而包老爺二十多年來仍無子嗣，直至原配夫人患病去迦後，包老爺有感膝下無子承繼家產，遂派親侄包大業往尋旺兩母子，知不尋獲，包老爺寧願臨老續娶求子，也不會把家業傳給親侄大業一直欲承繼包老爺家產，如今希望幻滅，遂起歪心，在尋到旺兩母子時，暗中加害之，旺母死，旺被打傷後腦滾下山崖業以為旺已死，即找來一個身份卑賤的孤兒，頂包假冒包老爺之子，改名為包繼宗大業並編造故事，令繼宗亦以為自己就是流落在外的包家少爺

programme.title: 他來自江湖:26
programme.desc: 反映現今社會，無論富或貧皆有誤入歧途的人，但祇要決心洗心革面，改邪歸正，社會必定會接納他們反之，那些死不悔改，繼續為非作歹的人，最終必會受到法律制裁，並且落得慘淡收場明天（萬梓良）原是黑道英雄，後因一次買賣中，未婚妻（楊寶玲）意外身亡，大受打擊之餘，決洗心革面，經營聯誼會為生明天與母親（李香琴），舅父何英彪（吳孟達）及表弟向鑫淼（周星馳）同住，彪一直懷疑天是當年導致他被革離警隊的人，故對他諸多單打

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: 我們的翻譯官
programme.desc: 講述了翻譯官林西和語譯天下公司首席技術官肖一成，解開心結，一起追求夢想，互相理解互相成就，最終有情人終成眷屬，實現職業夢想的故事！

programme.title: 城中之城
programme.desc: 聚焦2018年前後金融改革與發展，以兩代金融人的迷茫與奮鬥守正與搏殺的人生抉擇為切入口，全景式地展開金融城內銀行證券信託投行地產商等各色人等的命運沉浮，折射出金融改革與發展大時代的奔湧浪潮！

programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hus first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph. (这部多次获奖的电影是王胡斯首次独奏制作,)

programme.title: The Grand Substitution ((万古流芳))
programme.desc: Winner of Best Picture in the 12th Asian Film Festival, this Huangmei Opera epic stars Li Li Hua and Ivy Ling Po in a romance that stretches across the decades. (获得第12届亚洲电影节最佳电影奖,这部黄美歌剧中,李丽华和艾维琳波饰演了跨越数十年的浪漫.)

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman ((游侠儿))
programme.desc: This entertaining Robin Hood epic features a hero who steals from the thieves and gives to the poor which sets the thieves on the warpath. (这个娱乐性罗宾汉史诗的主角 偷盗盗贼的英雄 给穷人钱 给那些把小偷放进异教徒的贼)

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler ((玉女嬉春))
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung. (这部伊诺伊·乌梅茨古音乐剧描绘了两个歌唱妹妹,)

programme.title: Brothers Five ((兄弟 Five))
programme.desc: Superstar Cheng Pei-pei stars as Yen Lai, the one woman who can reunite the Kao brothers in a bid to save the Teng Lung Manor and avenge their fathers death. (佩饰演莱,她是唯一能团结卡奥兄弟的女人,)

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu ((疯猴))
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master Lau Kar Leung is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame. (卡勒被一个无情的恶棍伤后,他教了一个男孩子拳拳来报复他的羞耻.)

programme.title: Perils of the Sentimental Swordsman ((楚留香之幽灵山庄))
programme.desc: This well-named cliffhanger is fraught with adventure involving a mystery swordsman, a sensual swordswoman, an imperial assassin, a Ghost Mansion and more! (这个名声卓著的悬崖悬崖人 充满了冒险 包括神秘剑客 性感剑客 帝国刺客 鬼屋等等)

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee ((新陈三五娘))
programme.desc: The films curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty. (电影的奇怪标题指的是两个道具, 标志着一个幸福的开始,)

programme.title: House of Traps ((House of 青出于蓝s))
programme.desc: The Venoms bid a fond farewell to their internationally beloved film series with this saga about a building that bristles with booby-trapped blades. (毒品家以此传说, 关于一个建筑物,)

programme.title: The Kid With a Tattoo ((通天小子红枪客))
programme.desc: Starring kung-fu comedienne Wang Yu on a mission of justice, this film is kicked into high gear by Yuen Hua, Yuan Pin and the villainous Wang Lung-wei. (在司法任务中主演的拳喜剧女演员王,这部电影由华,平和恶棍王龙威起.)

programme.title: The Fastest Sword ((天下第一剑))
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry Kings famous 1950s film about a persecuted swordsman. (从作家导演潘·莱来看,这部关于一个被迫害的剑手的汉尼·金斯1950年代著名电影的中国版本.)

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden ((小龙女))
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story. (旧和新的混合在一起,创造了一个遥远的时代动作爱情故事.)

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist ((霹雳拳))
programme.desc: To save his son from being killed, the head of the Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends his son to be hidden by a master fighter. Will the boy prove a hero? (为了拯救他的儿子免遭杀害, 平安派拳击学院的负责人将他的儿子送到一个战士的隐藏.)

programme.title: The Deadly Duo ((双侠))
programme.desc: The iron triangle comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic. (导演长切和明星戴维·清和蒂隆组成的铁三角形,)

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers quintessential Huangmei Opera costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng. (这部电影标志着肖兄弟的典型黄美歌剧服装剧,)

programme.title: The Dragon Creek ((龙虎沟))
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer. (在她第一部角色中,虎,隐藏龙恶人成佩佩扮演了功夫的南西德鲁,)

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber ((红楼梦))
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families. (这部史诗经典描绘了两个青少年表弟之间的浪漫关系,)

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperors Power ((封神劫))
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him. (王朝的李王子和他的妻子李兰被流亡后,他自杀了.)

programme.title: Love Parade ((璇宫艳史))
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designers creations, but love follows regardless. (医生批评时尚设计师的创作时, 闪的光线会飞翔,)

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother ((书剑恩仇录))
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement. (这部史诗描述了陈洛和他的士兵如何说服清皇帝隆承认他的汉血统并加入反清运动.)

programme.title: Na Cha the Great ((哪吒‎))
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor. (一个年轻的叛军在重生后进入传说中,)

programme.title: The Proud Twins ((小鱼儿与花无缺))
programme.desc: This tale of hidden treasure features the legendary Alexander Fu Sheng as a young wushu warrior, in a film considered director Chu Yuans best ever. (这部关于隐藏的宝藏的故事, 传奇人物亚历山大·福·申格扮演着一个年轻的武士战士.)

programme.title: Bursting Point ((爆裂点))
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord. (一次失败的毒品突袭让一名秘密警察陷入困境,一名毒品子发誓要报复.)

programme.title: Hong Kong Family ((奸人世家))
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart. (一个8年前在一个灾难性的冬日变节晚餐中被撕裂的家庭,)

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey. (经过多年的自我忽视,决定重新接受生活.遇到拳击教练,她渴望重新开始.)

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques ((古董局中局))
programme.desc: Despite his familys expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan resents their fraudulent ways. However, when fate shows him a route to redeeming their reputation, will he survive it? (尽管他的家人对古老中国遗物的专业知识,徐元却不满他们的欺诈方式.)

programme.title: Mamas Affair ((巨星养成记))
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life. (由前人才经理Mei Fung Kearen Pang导演的香港戏剧, 退休照顾丈夫的儿子,)

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: Set in the 90s during the Hong Kong handover, this drama depicts how a bookworm rises to become a formidable leader in the triads. (这部剧描述一头书呆虫如何升起成为三合会的强大领袖。)

programme.title: Back To The Past ((寻秦记))
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself. (在帮助英正团结中国之后,洪小龙在隔离中生活了20年,直到旅行者返回重写历史,迫使他们保卫秦朝和命运。)

programme.title: Reunion Dinner (聚会晚餐)
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control. (当一个订婚夫妇被要求邀请父母参加CNY客户活动时,与母亲疏远的未婚夫假装了家庭.)

programme.title: Life Must Go On ((The Show Must Go On（1991年皇后乐队演唱歌曲）))
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it. (当那些反逆的青少年女孩的午夜体育馆计划因资金而面临关闭的风险时,社会工作者Yanki组建了一个球队,)

programme.title: Atonement ((下一个就是你))
programme.desc: Ah Long lives in hardship with his daughter. When she is abducted in Thailand, Longs faith shatters, and he risks everything to track down the trafficking ring, transforming into a vengeful killer.

programme.title: Peg O My Heart ((赎梦))
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares, night-shift taxi driver Choi meets psychiatrist Dr. Man. In therapy, Man begins to experience disturbing and perplexing dreams, blurring the line between reality and illusion. (经过梦,夜班出租车司机乔遇到了精神科医生曼. 在治疗中,曼开始经历令人不安和困惑的梦想,)

programme.title: Under Current ((内幕))
programme.desc: The death of a charitys CFO and a missing donation force lawyer Ma into an alliance with a police officer. Together, they risk everything to uncover the charitys darkest secrets and seek justice. (慈善机构的首席财务官和失踪的捐赠部队律师Ma与一名警察结盟,他们一起冒着一切风险来揭露慈善机构最黑暗的秘密,)

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1 ((倚天屠龙记之九阳神功))
programme.desc: First instalment of the new remake of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, adapted from Jin Yongs novel, see Zhang Wu Ji embroiled in a dispute involving two legendary weapons. (根据金永的小说改编的"天堂剑和龙剑"的新改版,第一部,看到张武吉卷入了涉及两个传奇武器的争端.)

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads FRANK, sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey? (那些年轻的盗窃者在珠宝商店抢劫后,留下了一个写 FRANK 的涂标签,引起了人们对他们的动机的好奇.)

programme.title: The Sleep Curse ((乱马½))
programme.desc: After two cult classic films from the 90s - director Herman Yau Anthony Wong reunite, and together with Gordon Lam, Michelle Wai Jojo Goh, challenge your limit in this paranormal thriller. (导演Herman Yau Anthony Wong 重新团聚, 与戈登·拉姆、米歇尔·韦·乔乔·高一起,)

programme.title: Beyond The Sin ((宝可梦))
programme.desc: Inspector Yans daughter is found dead, and her classmate Wen is arrested. However, when another killing occurs after Wens imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect that the true killer is still at large. (检查员女儿被发现死了,同学被捕.然而,在被关押后,又发生了谋杀事件,开始怀疑真正的杀手仍然在逃亡.)

programme.title: Honey Money Phony ((“骗骗”喜欢你2))
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process. (林被一个浪漫的骗局欺骗,并被巨额债务负担,她与骗子奥扬合作,要求她收回钱.)

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood ((虎毒不))
programme.desc: Shu Zhens life takes a downturn after giving birth. Exhausted by childcare, ignored by her husband and burdened by in-laws and work, she endures lonely nights. Will dawn bring her hope or despair? (子出生后,她生活发生了衰退.她因照顾孩子而疲,被丈夫忽视,以及因岳父和工作而负担,她忍受了孤独的夜晚.)

programme.title: Atonement ((下一个就是你))
programme.desc: Ah Long lives in hardship with his daughter. When she is abducted in Thailand, Longs faith shatters, and he risks everything to track down the trafficking ring, transforming into a vengeful killer.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009 ((家有喜事2009))
programme.desc: Yu Chu is brilliant but impossible to date. Her brother hires love expert Dick to woo her and break a curse but Yu Chu falls for him fast and wont let Dick go without a fight. (楚很聪明,但没有人可以和她约会.她的哥哥雇佣了爱情专家迪克,)

programme.title: Death Stranding ((死亡搁浅))
programme.desc: The Police and gambling association team up to overhaul underground gambling by auctioning new casino licenses. This unveils the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs... (警方和博协会将通过拍卖新场许可证,共同改革地下博.)

programme.title: One and Only ((我的唯一))
programme.desc: A veteran and a passionate street dancer both strive to reach their goals and pursue their dreams in street dancing. After overcoming many challenges, can they finally shine on stage? (一个老年人和一个热情的街舞者都努力实现自己的目标,并追求街舞的梦想.)

programme.title: Call Of Heroes ((Call Of 英雄es))
programme.desc: Sean Lau, Louise Koo Eddie Peng star in this action-packed story of a group of villagers who stand up to a cruel young warlord to protect their home. (Sean Lau, Louise Koo Eddie Peng 明星,在这个行动故事中, 一群村民站在一个残酷的年轻军阀面前 保护他们的家园。)

programme.title: The New Youth XII Ep04 (新青年 XII Ep04)
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick! (纪录片系列讲述中国年轻人,)

programme.title: Pixel Collage (像素拼接)
programme.desc: A well-crafted collage of selected short documentaries telling stories about all aspects of China! People, technology, culture, and wildlife, all are showcased in Internet-friendly form. (精心制作的短片纪录片,讲述了中国各个方面的故事!)

programme.desc: Dave Turin joins Juan in Alaska for their first-ever double rescue - they must battle a massive, 30-foot wash plant fix to get 150 oz. of gold. (戴夫·都灵和胡安一起前往阿拉斯加 进行第一次双倍救援 他们必须战斗一个30英尺高的大型洗涤厂)

programme.title: The Last Woodsmen S2 Ep09 ((最后的樵夫 S2 Ep09))
programme.desc: Chasing a royalty-free payday, Jared bets half his crew on an abandoned claim. With 1m due in 8 weeks, it could win - or sink - the Forever Claim. (贾雷德在追逐免特许使用费的发薪日,用被放弃的索赔要求打赌其船员的一半。 8周内有1米到期,它就可以赢得 — — 或沉没 — — 永久索赔要求。)

programme.title: Deadliest Catch S13 Ep03 ((渔人的搏斗 S13 Ep03))
programme.desc: Rising sea temperatures test the fleet. Toxic smoke engulfs the Saga. Sean struggles to save the family business on the Brenna A.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch S13 Ep04 ((渔人的搏斗 S13 Ep04))
programme.desc: Wild Bill uncovers the truth about Nick McGlashans terminal illness. A damaging mechanical issue threatens to crush Jakes future.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch S13 Ep05 ((渔人的搏斗 S13 Ep05))
programme.desc: Johnathan and Andy Hillstrand fish together for the last time. Keiths inattentive crew sends the Wizard on a collision course.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters S8 Ep11
programme.desc: Increasingly desperate, The Mooka Boys beg for scraps in an old mine, but a discovery could change their fortunes. Machinery failures hit The Cheals.

programme.title: Exploring the Unknown With Wang Yibo S1 Ep03 ((探索新境 S1 Ep03))
programme.desc: Explorer Wang Hao takes artist Wang Yibo on an extreme cave exploration trip in Guilin, Guangxi.

programme.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy Juan S5 Ep01 ((淘金热：矿山救援 S5 Ep01))
programme.desc: Freddy and Juan reveal never-before-seen rescue footage, exposing rarely seen highs and lows on their mission to help miners get the gold.

programme.title: House of Sharks

programme.title: The Last Woodsmen S2 Ep10 ((最后的樵夫 S2 Ep10))
programme.desc: With production stalled and their shot at the Forever Claim slipping away, Jared and crew race to build a backwoods bridge to reopen the logging road.

programme.title: Mystery at Blind Frog Ranch S5 Ep01
programme.desc: When Duane Ollinger falls ill, treasure hunter Josh Feldman takes over the hunt for Aztec gold. The team uncover a Mormon journal that holds clues.

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep03 ((生动海滩 S1 Ep03))

programme.desc: Check in with the centres resident turkey vulture, whos ready for release and in search of a flock.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2 Ep01 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S2 Ep01))
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv. (在繁殖季节,与米克和阿德尔交往,他们拯救了杰克·拉塞尔从一个皮的鱼.)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2 Ep02 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S2 Ep02))
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python. (准备好救援,当丹和杰斯从后院里取出东方棕色的,然后当米克在沙发枕头里嗅出一种高度有毒的蛇时, 保持呼吸.)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2 Ep03 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S2 Ep03))
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan. (看到米克和阿德尔抓住一个子监视器鱼追着子晚餐,然后抓住一个滑滑车库入侵者和杰斯和丹.)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2 Ep04 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S2 Ep04))
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies. (让斯图和利夫乱,他们试图取一个大蓝舌. 让杰斯和丹一起跑时间,他们试图拯救一个怀孕的蛇,)

programme.title: Wild Science S1 Ep03 (野生科学S1Ep03)
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in. (重新审视褐熊的进化历程,从主宰冰河时代的乌希德祖先到现代食肉动物。 见证它们与鲑鱼的共生关系以及它们生长的令人惊讶的相互关联的生态系统。)

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala S1 Ep01 ((Secret 终生惩戒 of the Koala S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australias best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions. (尽管是澳大利亚最知名的类动物之一,但可拉只生活在非洲大陆东部和东南部.)

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala S1 Ep02 ((Secret 终生惩戒 of the Koala S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. (虽然可拉似乎孤独和无力,但交配时代会带来他们的行为发生巨大变化,导致运动,接触和冲突.)

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep01 (动物帝国 S1 Ep01)

programme.title: The Living Beach S1 Ep04 ((生动海滩 S1 Ep04))

(在不远的未来,社会由强大的国家和一个名为"总监"的独裁者控制.康多为国家工作为一名杀手,但与他认为已经死了的人相聚,迫使他考虑他的敌人是谁.)

programme.title: The Wedding Veil: Journey ((婚纱的旅途))
programme.desc: Tracy and Nick agree to set aside work to make time for a long overdue honeymoon to Greece. When they are stranded on a secluded island, they confront their life choices. (特雷西和尼克同意把工作放在一边,以便有时间去希腊度过长期的蜜月旅行.)

programme.title: The Hanger ((环世界))
programme.desc: Like in fairy tale. A dreamy girl or young woman in a cottage. Cockroaches seem to be the only thing hampering her. (像童话说中的样子,一个梦幻少女或一个小屋里的年轻女人.)

programme.title: The Wedding Veil: Expectations ((婚纱的期望))
programme.desc: Avery and Peter try to keep the romance alive while renovating an old house and juggling work, but everything takes on a new perspective when Avery has a surprise for Peter. (艾弗里和彼得试图保持浪漫的活力 同时改造旧房子和杂耍工作 但是当艾弗里给彼得一个惊喜时 一切都有了新的视角)

programme.title: Babysitter ((保姆俱乐部))
programme.desc: In the midst of a messy divorce, Rays clueless mom hires Anjelika, the eccentric daughter of a dead popstar to babysit his younger sister Stella. Anjelika gets along well with teenage Ray and even tries to help Ray win the affections of his crush, Sadie. Soon, Ray and Anjelika form a special bond, which threatens to jeopardize his mothers master plan to gain custody of Ray and Stella. (在一个混乱的离婚中,雷斯的无知母亲聘请了死去的流行明星的奇特女儿安吉利卡照顾他的妹妹斯特拉.安吉利卡和青少年雷很好地相处,甚至试图帮助雷赢得他爱情的情感,萨迪.很快,雷和安吉利卡形成了特殊的纽带,这威胁到他的母亲的主计划,以获得雷和斯特拉的监护权.)

programme.title: A Picture Of Her ((她的照片))
programme.desc: Beth becomes the subject of an award-winning magazines cover and goes on a quest to find the photographer who snapped her photo. (贝丝成为获奖杂志封面的主题, 并继续寻找摄影师 拍摄她的照片。)

programme.title: Somethings Brewing
programme.desc: As Janes life spins out of control, she finds hope and new love in a local coffee shop. (简斯的生活失控了 她在当地咖啡店找到了希望和新爱)

programme.title: Sister Of The Bride ((新娘的妹妹))
programme.desc: After only 6 months of dating, Stephanie and Ben get engaged and are delighted to share the news. However, they hit a road bump when Stephanies parents show concern that the couple has moved too fast. (斯蒂芬妮和本刚刚约会了六个月后,他们订婚,很高兴分享这段消息.)

programme.title: Black Water: Abyss ((绝命鳄口))
programme.desc: Trapped in a flooded cave, a group of adventurers fighting for survival realise they have another thing to worry about: a pack of hungry crocodiles. (陷入一个淹没的洞穴中, 一群为了生存而战的冒险家意识到他们还有别的问题:)

programme.title: A Picture Of Her ((她的照片))

programme.title: Somethings Brewing

programme.title: Violent Night ((暴力之夜))
programme.desc: When an elite team of mercenaries breaks into a family compound on Christmas Eve, a disgruntled Santa Claus must take them out to save both the hostages and his Holiday. (当一个精英的雇佣军团队在圣诞节前夕入侵家庭的建筑物时,一个不满意的圣诞老人必须把他们带走,)

programme.title: Lucy ((我爱露西))
programme.desc: A woman, accidentally caught in a dark deal, turns the tables on her captors and transforms into a merciless warrior evolved beyond human logic. (一个女人,意外被困在一个黑暗的交易中, 转移了桌子对她的绑架者, 转变为一个无情的战士, 进化超越人类逻辑.)

programme.title: The Mummy ((木乃伊))
programme.desc: 2,000 years ago in Egypt, Princess Ahmanet was buried alive in a tomb beneath the desert as punishment for killing her father. The ancient princess is awakened in the modern era when her tomb is rediscovered. Holding a malevolent grudge that has grown over millennia, once resurrected she begins spreading terrors on earth that defy human comprehension. (两千年前,阿曼尼特公主在埃及被活埋在沙漠下一个坟墓里,作为惩罚,因为她杀死了父亲.当她墓被重新发现时,古代公主在现代时代醒来.)

programme.desc: Finn and family find out all there is to know about giraffes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. If only we had more Duggees muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggees Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Hurricane Rescue
programme.desc: Grim HQ struggles through the sky above the Atlantic Ocean, fighting against the powerful winds of a hurricane. One Grimbot falls overboard before the ship crash-lands at Go Jet Academy. Needing another ship to rescue the missing Grimbot, Grandmaster Glitch steals Jetpad. The Go Jetters give chase in the Grimbler, heading right into the eye of the storm.

programme.title: Roots Fruits S02 - Okra
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its the spectacular music duo, Okra, playing the floor piano together in perfect sync.

programme.title: Roots Fruits S02 - Asparagus
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its young Asparagus sharing his deep affection to wet weather in the song I Love The Rain.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Young Veggies: Part 2
programme.desc: Supertato reveals how he learned to control his potato powers, defeat Evil Pea and save the supermarket for the very first time.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Baos chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Qin Ai De Hai Zi Men
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Final Justice 1988
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggars gang when he saves the gangs elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the directors previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killers claims of an evil spell, then it doesnt let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the others mole.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiaos spirit is revived to take revenge when the dolls eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a Phantom Bullet that kills without a trace. programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Rope Burn
programme.desc: When distracted spotter Birch turns away for a minute, Sandra falls and ends up twisting her ankle. Feeling immensely guilty, Birch offers her assistance, which Sandra promptly begins to take advantage. Suspecting shes being exploited, Birch sets Sandra up for a big fall in front of the whole school at a poetry slam.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Theres No Business...
programme.desc: A chance to shine in a community film festival sees Liam behind the camera trying to direct Sandra, who becomes a prima donna the second Action! is called. Unfortunately shes not very good actor, eventually causing her costar Raffi to quit. In a stroke of genius, Birch figures out how she and Liam can save their movie, even if it means potentially suffering the wrath of Sandra

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Growing Pains
programme.desc: Birch is made painfully aware how, by being one year younger than the rest of her classmates, she is treated differently: from being too young to see a horror movie or gaining entrance to an exhibit at the museum. This leads her podmates to treat her differently and for Antoine to think he and Birch must be soul mates or at least age mates.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And The Family Photo
programme.desc: Mother is determined to take the perfect family Christmas photo in the middle of the summer. With the help of a snow machine, Olivia takes it upon herself to bring a little Christmas spirit to the photograph, and to Francines backyard beach party next door.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Goes Camping
programme.desc: Francine comes along reluctantly on Olivias family camping trip, and Olivia cant believe that anyone could be so unprepared for life in the great outdoors. But with a little hiking, bug-catching, and marshmallow roasting, Olivia is sure she can transform Francine from a novice to an expert camper.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia The Nature Photographer
programme.desc: After snapping some great photos of her cat Edwin, Olivia thinks shes ready to photograph some real wild animals. She and Julian camp out in the backyard to wait for some, and sure enough they track down a mysterious animal in the bushes. But is it really a wild beast?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - The Two Olivias
programme.desc: Theres a new girl in Olivias class and her name is...Olivia! Confusion ensues, and Olivia the original Olivia cant believe that she shares her name with another person. After a brief stint calling herself Pam, Olivia eventually decides that a two Olivia town might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Hammy in the House To Go Lunch
programme.desc: When Eden finds an injured Hammy out of his cage and helps him recuperate in her own home, she finds it harder and harder to get her new guest to return to his own home. When Lula and Luis want a clubhouse for the Squasher Fan Club, TZG secretly help fix up the shed in Luis backyard.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - It Takes a Zenko What a Racket
programme.desc: When various townsfolk report having lost soft belongings, TZG secretly investigates to discover thieving pigeon Yolanda had been building a nest for baby gophers. When Ians lucky badminton racket goes missing, TZG secretly finds and returns it in time for a rematch against his toughest opponent.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - 2500 Candles For Ra Its A Mad Mad Mad Underworld

programme.title: Caspers Scare School S1 - Curse Of The Sandwich A Real Little Monster

But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Cakeys Cupcake Cousins

Cakey welcomes his Cousins to the dollhouse and leads them through a fun-filled itinerary of activities, but quickly realizes his cousins have an agenda of their own. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Gratitude
programme.desc: When Phoebes Gratitude Day card flies away before she can give it to Marcus, the Dews try to help her recreate it - perfectly. But they learn that you dont have to be perfect to show your gratitude for someone. When Athena finds herself a little short-handed at the Fairhaven Summer Fair, her cousin, Reed, comes to help only to give Athena more problems to fix.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Glue Dew Believer
programme.desc: When Harpers ceramic dragon is smashed, the Dews must find all the pieces. But when a piece ends up missing, the Dews work together to create a new piece, hoping no one will notice. Dylan goes to great lengths to invite his Dew Drop to his soccer game but, in the process, learns that sometimes believing in something is more powerful than seeing something.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Best Friends Day The White Whale
programme.desc: Pixie loves to ride the clouds, but she cant understand why Kelp doesnt love it, too. If they dont agree on this, does that mean theyre not best friends anymore? Kelp helps Ollie fulfill his dream of watching the white whale migration.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Shark and Pilot Fish Theo
programme.desc: When shark and pilot fish are separated its up to Kelp, Scallop, Cruz, and Waverly to help them find each other again. Scallops friend Theo finally comes clean on why hes always rushing off.

programme.desc: When Ruffnut is captured by Dragon Hunters, its up to Astrid and Tuffnut to defend Dragons Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army Dragons Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - A Time To Skrill

programme.desc: The team heads into a final confrontation for the weapons that not only threatens Tikal, but their lives. And Po must share hero duties with Mastodon.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Lights, Camera, Org Chart!

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Night Of The Hunters Pt 2
programme.desc: As Hiccup and Snotlout race to rescue the others from Ryker and the Dragon Hunters, they dont realize Dagur and Heather are working with the enemy

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: After a strange creature bites Tuffnut, he believes hell turn into a legendary Lycanwing dragon when the moon is full unless his friends can save him

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snoutlout Gets The Axe
programme.desc: When Snotlout and Astrid must fly a ceremonial battle axe to a family wedding, they must work together when an Armorwing dragon derails their plan

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Maces And Talons Pt 1
programme.desc: When they learn the Dragon Hunters are tracking the Flightmare, Hiccup and Astrid race to stop them after Heather spills secrets from Viggo Grimborn

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Maces And Talons Pt 2
programme.desc: After Heather and the Flightmare have been captured by Viggo and the Dragon Hunters, Hiccup must develop a plan to outwit this dangerous new enemy

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Enemy Of My Enemy
programme.desc: After Hiccup is shot down on a remote island while searching for Viggo and the Dragon Hunters, he questions Dagurs intentions to rescue him.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Crash Course
programme.desc: When a dangerous subterranean Cavern Crasher dragon invades the Fireworm Queens underground nest, she approaches the Riders on Dragons Edge for help.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Follow The Leader
programme.desc: When Fishlegs discovers a hidden civilization of Albino Night Terrors beneath Dragons Edge, he must craft an escape plan after they attack the Riders.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Buffalord Soldier
programme.desc: Astrid comes down with the Odins Revenge flu and the Riders must search for the cure by finding a nearly extinct Buffalord dragon before Viggo does.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - A Grim Retreat
programme.desc: The Riders head to a tropical island for fun in the sun, not realizing its infested with Grimora Leeches which drives their dragons to turn on them.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Theres No Phil in Team

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Thunder Games

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Shock and Awww
programme.desc: Guy is always surprising Eep with romantic gestures and Eep wants to return the favor. But when Guy proves impossible to surprise, Eep has to step up her game.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Everest Returns
programme.desc: Following the events of the feature, Yi struggles to recreate her violin magic without Everest. While her mom and NaiNai prepare for the grand opening of their family dumpling shop, Yi, Jin, and Peng discover that Yis violin has attracted a magical bird-like creature, Fenghuang, who needs their help. Yis music also calls on Everest, who returns to join the crew and find Fenghuang a suitable home

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Welcome Home, Everest!

programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，天龙八部更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材nn故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰杨佑宁饰大理世子段誉白澍饰少林小僧虚竹张天阳饰三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出情这一字带来的痛苦纠缠.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 世界观 今日知多D News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻.

programme.title: 东张西望 Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 死有对证 Cause Of Death
programme.desc: 新任女法医程芷昕陈晓华饰从小受林琛韦家雄饰启发，立志加入法医科，入职后却被上司林琛投闲置散林琛与身为重案组高级督察的前妻高淑娴王绮琴饰水火不容，两人因女儿林雪蕾离家出走而再次交集芷昕凭借认真的工作态度赢得林琛认同，并与警员高俊马贯东饰结缘，三人渐成默契十足的办案铁三角芷昕闺密单佩嘉吴若希饰经历失恋失业打击后转任港闻记者，跟资深记者詹柏宇阮浩棕饰从欢喜冤家发展成互相扶持的伙伴正当芷昕事业步入正轨，却闻好友佩嘉死讯，誓要还原真相，为逝者发声！.

programme.title: 剥茧 The Truth Within
programme.desc: 第十五集n胡洁家头发与阮明宇吻合，但他供称只是为查明无名画秘密而持备用钥匙入屋，核查后并未说谎他透露十四年前曾拍到胡洁向湖中丢弃疑似凶器的钢笔，且胡洁所爱之人其实倾心樊降雪此人竟是齐思哲师兄陈楚川；同时老宋遗留药物也装在其诊所药袋陈楚川数日未现身，警方认定他涉两桩命案，全面部署抓捕.

programme.title: 蓝朋友．旅朋友 温哥华篇 Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: 王祖蓝一条麻甩到东莞汕头之后，延续系列的真实风格再拍摄旅游节目不过，这趟旅途上会多了一些朋友同行，主轴更是要沿着祖蓝生命中的里程坐标，开展连场深度回访，发掘市井生活中的趣味与温情这次取景版图横跨福州广西温哥华，三个极具特色的地方，都在祖蓝不同的人生阶段留下了重大意义祖蓝分别与三组旅朋友走过街巷，从故乡情缘到文化启蒙，再往最重要的爱情归宿，以旅程片段诉说属于王祖蓝独一无二的故事.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 碧血鹽梟 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Melati gagal membuat fitnah bagi memisahkan Luna dengan Areeq. Rysa telah memberitahu Luna yang Areeq menyukainya, sudah sampai masanya bagi Areeq menyatakan perasaannya kepada Luna. Manakala Iman mencabar Areeq, best man win bagi memiliki Luna semula. Areeq membawa Luna keluar berbuka puasa bersama-sama, Areeq mengakui dia sudah jatuh hati kepada Luna. programme.title: Pink Smile

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Iman membuka rahsia Melati sengaja membuat kecoh kerana mahu mendapatkan cinta Areeq termasuk memburuknya nama Luna di hadapan kakitangan lain. Areeq cuba menyampaikan rasa cintanya secara berkias kepada Luna, manakala Luna masih tidak pasti dengan cinta Areeq. Keadaan ini membuat Iman merasakan dia masih ada harapan memiliki Luna. Rysa ternampak Luna berjumpa dengan Iman, perkara tersebut diberitahu kepada Areeq, membuat Areeq rasa cemburu. Melati balik ke kampung selepas dimarahi oleh Areeq. Melati membuat fitnah mengatakan Areeq telah menodainya

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Osman percayakan cerita anaknya Melati bahawa Areeq telah menodainya. Osman bertemu Hj Mahadi, dia mendesak Areeq mesti berkahwin dengan Melati. Areeq terpaksa balik bagi selesaikan masalah tersebut sehingga terlupa temujanjinya dengan Luna. Luna merajuk dan masih syak cinta Areeq tidak sepenuhnya. Areeq berjaya membongkar semua cerita palsu Melati, Pak Osman meminta maaf atas kesalahan anaknya. Iman mengambil kesempatan untuk mendapatkan semula cinta Luna. Faiz balik dari luar negara, dia berhubung semula dengan Rysa. Akhirnya Areeq berjaya mencurahkan perasaannya kepada Luna, malangnya cinta Luna masih berbelah bahagi samada memilih Areeq atau Iman.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Memaparkan Iman muncul di hadapan Luna dan Areeq, lantas menarik Luna keluar. Nasib baik Luna berjaya melepaskan diri. Luna kecewa dengan dirinya kerana tidak membalas cinta Areeq. Luna masih belum dapat membuat keputusan samada memilih Iman atau Areeq menjadi kekasihnya. Areeq balik ke kampung kerana merajuk. Luna akhirnya membuat keputusan, cintanya hanya pada Areeq. Perkara tersebut diberitahu kepada Iman. Pada pagi hari raya, Tuan Irsyad, isteri dan Luna datang beraya ke rumah Hj Mahadi. Luna dan Areeq mulai mesra kembali. Areq kemudiannya melamar Luna sebagai isteri, Luna bersedia menjadi isterinya sampai ke Jannah

programme.title: 11 Cinta Sebelum Kamu
programme.desc: Ray, bekas playboy, melamar tunangnya Khadeja. Namun ibunya, Dato Shikin - seorang ibu tunggal dan peguam - menetapkan syarat unik untuk restu: Ray mesti meminta maaf secara peribadi kepada 11 bekas teman wanitanya, merakam momen itu dalam tempoh 30 hari

programme.title: Celebs Day Off
programme.desc: Saksikan bagaimana seorang selebriti mengisi hari cuti mereka dengan bermacam aktiviti-aktiviti menarik. Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan kali ini, Fadhli Masoot.

programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan The Amin Cap dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Gaya Kerjaya Haiqal Helmy dan Bedah Kotak Marrow - Jett Moc Derby

programme.title: Concert Dia.. Lagenda Unplugged Dato Yusni Hamid
programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Dato Yusni Hamid berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.

programme.title: Kahwin 5
programme.desc: Dr K Usop Wilcha ialah seorang usahawan mangkuk plastik dari Perak yang sudah mempunyai empat isteri dari negeri berbeza Selangor, Kelantan, Negeri Sembilan, Sabah. Kehidupannya tenang hingga dia terlibat dengan skandal bersama Farra, seorang setiausaha muda yang bersaudara dengan ketua gangster, Cico. Dr K ditekan untuk berkahwin lagi - mencetus dilema: kekalkan empat isteri atau cerai salah seorang demi menyelamatkan nyawa

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa mengambil kesempatan kepada anak Muhammad, TJ untuk membuatkan Shahira berasa cemburu. Shariff berdepan dengan masalah judi dan meminta wang dengan Shida dengan alasan hendak memulakan perniagaan. Keadaan Siti semakin sakit dan akhirnya di bawa ke hospital oleh Kamini. Arissa juga merapatkan diri dengan Muhammad sehingga menyebabkan Shida berasa marah.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya berasa rimas apbila meneriman panggilan dari Syarfan berpuluh kali sehari. Dia percaya bahwa Syarfan ada menyembunyikan sesuatu darinya. Dia meluahkan rasa hatinya kepada Najwan yang telah menjadi bodyguard adik iparnya,Syafinaz . Syafinaz mula berasa sayang kepada Najwan. Antasya menemui gambr-gambar Syarfan bersama seorang perempuan dalam bilik stor dan yakin bahawa perempuan tersebut mempunya jawapan kepada persoalannya.

programme.title: Orang Itu
programme.desc: Seorang lelaki yang berpandangan prejudis menghalau seorang wanita gelandangan yang tidur di belakang restorannya. Beliau terkejut apabila isterinya membawa wanita itu ke rumah mereka untuk tinggal bersama.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Khabar berita tentang Iskandar dan Aisyah bercuti bersama sampai ke pengetahuan Tengku Maria. Kepulangan Iskandar dan Aisyah ke kondo mengejutkan mereka dengan keberadaan Tengku Maria di dalam kondo itu, Iskandar tergamam melihat Tengku Maria . Iskandar mencari alasan dia terpaksa bawa Aisyah ke kondo itu sementara menanti Haziq. Sangka Iskandar Tengku Maria mahu menerima alasan itu, namun dia tidak menyangka Tengku Maria telah datang semula ke kondo miliknya dan bertemu dengan Aisyah. Tengku Maria telah menghalau Aisyah dari kondo itu dan menuduh Aisyah adalah perempuan simpanan Iskandar. Aisyah cuba merayu tetapi dia tidak mampu lagi, hujan dan petir yang kuat tidak melembutkan hati Tengku Mummy untuk memaafkan Aisyah. Iskandar yang kepenatan tidak menyedari akan apa yang sedang terjadi. Iskandar mencari kehilangan Aisyah pada esok hari.

programme.title: Jalan Puncak Alam
programme.desc: Jalan Puncak Alam mengisahkan seorang pelajar UiTM bernama Azizi yang terpaksa melalui jalan sunyi itu pada lewat malam untuk pulang ke rumah selepas bekerja di kampus. Dalam perjalanan, motosikal yang ditunggang Azizi tiba-tiba kehabisan minyak. Azizi kemudian menghubungi Hanif untuk meminta bantuan. Hanif segera menuju ke tempat motosikal Azizi rosak dan dari situ, mereka diganggu oleh makhluk halus. Apabila Hanif dan Azizi melihat keadaan sekeliling, hampir semuanya telah selesai, namun pertemuan mereka dengan seorang pemancing telah membuka satu perkara yang tidak masuk akal.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.
