programme.desc: Abang Long Fadil, seorang lelaki yang sentiasa berangan bahawa kehidupannya seperti seorang gangster. Tetapi apabila sahabat baiknya, Malik dimasukkan ke penjara, lebih banyak kekacauan berlaku dan angan-angannya mungkin tidak jauh berbeza daripada realiti.

programme.title: Nasi Tangas
programme.desc: Hairi dan Fatin adalah seorang kawan rapat. Mereka berdua bersama-sama membangunkan sebuah kafe yang dibuka bersama-sama. Hubungan mereka adalah seperti sepasang kekasih, tetapi Hairi dan Fatin tidak pernah lebih daripada seorang rakan. Mira juga rakan yang baik untuk Fatin. Mira mengakui bahawa dia jatuh cinta dengan Hairi.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Munafik 2
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan menakutkan, seorang penyembuh muslim mendapati imannya diuji apabila membatu seorang perempuan yang terkurung didalam pertempuran, tubuh dan jiwa dengan seorang pemimpin yang jahat.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Nabila dan Amry mengetahui bahawa mereka pernah bertemu tiga tahun lalu di dunia nyata. Teruja dengan peluang untuk akhirnya berjumpa semula, mereka merancang pertemuan.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China And America
programme.desc: Berikutan serangan hendap dalam lawatannya ke Amerika, Wong Fei-hung terpisah daripada rakan-rakan pengembaranya dan mengalami kehilangan ingatan.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP16
programme.desc: Saiful Azmi Pengantara Detik 12 Malam dengan dibantu krew produksi melakukan penyiasatan tentang kisah misteri yang berlaku di Bandar Tasek Puteri, Rawang, Selangor. Tasek ini pernah di terokai sebagai pusat perlombongan satu masa lalu. Menurut Haji Fadzil Hanapie dan Shiriman Hakim Razali penduduk asal kawasan tersebut, mereka pernah ternampak mengalami peristiwa menyeramkan dan menakut bertemu dengan lembaga misteri dan sekumpulan lembaga berjubah putih yang dikatakn Bunian. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di lokasi tersebut selepas 12 malam. Pengantara sendiri mengalami kejadian seram apabila terhidu bau wangi bunga rampai dan dapat merasakan kehadiran lembaga misteri sebagai perkampungan Orang Bunian.

programme.title: Trilogi Cinta
programme.desc: Norjinah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah kepada Razif bagi melarikan diri daripada sikap bapa tirinya, Pak Badar. Razif kemudian berkahwin dengan Norjinah atas amanah arwah isterinya, Salmi, untuk menjaga anak-anak mereka. Walaupun perkahwinan mereka sering digugat fitnah Pak Badar, godaan Norseha, dan pelbagai konflik keluarga, Norjinah tetap tabah mempertahankan rumah tangga dan cintanya bersama Razif.

programme.title: Aku Jatuh Cinta
programme.desc: Dilahirkan dalam keluarga kaya bukanlah jaminan bahawa segala-galanya akan menjadi mudah. Itulah yang dirasai oleh Kevin. Bukannya menjadi pengarah di syarikat keluarganya, Kevin sebaliknya terpaksa bekerja sebagai kakitangan pembersihan housekeeping. Disebabkan kemelut tersebut, Kevin sebenarnya telah bertemu dengan Alana yang berjaya membuatkannya jatuh cinta. Namun sekali lagi, kenyataan tidaklah seindah impian, Kevin juga harus berjuang demi mengejar cintanya.

programme.title: My Love In The Countryside

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Meet Me After Sunset
programme.desc: Seorang remaja lelaki bernama Gadis bertemu Vino, seorang gadis misteri yang hanya boleh muncul selepas matahari terbenam. Persahabatan mereka perlahan-lahan berubah menjadi hubungan istimewa sambil menyimpan rahsia besar.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Air Zam Zam Untuk Mak
programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantunya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahajapulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

programme.title: Jubah Dari Mekah
programme.desc: Jubah Dari Mekah mengisahkan Mak Leha, ibu tunggal yang berjuang membesarkan anak-anaknya, Shakir dan Abil, yang ketagih dadah. Shakir tidak bersetuju Abil dikurung, namun tidak mampu mengubah keadaan apabila ibunya terpaksa mendapatkan dadah untuk Abil. Apabila Mak Leha merancang menunaikan umrah, abangnya bersetuju menunaikan ibadah itu bagi menggantikan Abil yang semakin teruk keadaannya.

programme.title: Ajari Aku Islam
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda bernama Kenny, yang berasal daripada latar belakang berbeza agama, mula mendalami Islam selepas mengenali seorang gadis Muslim bernama Fidya. Perjalanan ini membawa dia kepada perubahan besar dalam hidup, termasuk memahami erti cinta, kepercayaan, dan hidayah.

programme.title: Melukis Luka
programme.desc: Seorang wanita cuba menyembuhkan luka emosi dan trauma masa lalu sambil mencari kekuatan untuk meneruskan kehidupan. Filem ini mengetengahkan konflik keluarga, kehilangan, dan proses menerima diri sendiri.

programme.title: Balada Pencinta
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah cinta terlarang antara Amir, bekas ahli mafia, dan Aisyah, seorang pelajar seni. Amir ingin memulakan hidup baru sebagai pemuzik jalanan, dan pada suatu hari, dia bertemu dengan Aisyah yang juga berasal dari keluarga kaya.

programme.title: Aku Bukan Gila
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Andra yang pergi bercuti ke Wales dan bertemu dengan beberapa individu yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya. Di sebalik kehidupan yang kelihatan normal, dia berdepan dengan trauma dan konflik berkaitan kesihatan mental yang mempengaruhi dirinya

programme.title: Di Rumah Ini, Aku Selalu Salah

Wulan dan ibunya, Heni Irene Librawati, mula menerima gangguan daripada individu yang tidak dikenali, sekali gus menimbulkan persoalan tentang siapa yang berdendam terhadap keluarga mereka.

programme.desc: Persahabatan antara dua orang gadis, Pelangi dan Nirmala. Namun, persahabatan mereka ditentang oleh orang tua mereka kerana perbezaan strata sosial. Pelangi hidup dengan sederhana, sementara Nirmala hidup mewah.

programme.title: TRAIN TO BUSAN ((釜山行))

programme.title: Woo Fung Concert 2026
programme.desc: Veteran Hong Kong entertainer Woo Fung celebrates his remarkable seven-decade career with a spectacular concert at the Hong Kong Coliseum. At 94, he performs classic songs alongside star guests including Andy Lau, Jacky Cheung and Nick Cheung. Filled with music, laughter and touching memories, the concert also marks his Guinness World Record as the oldest Chinese artist to hold a solo concert.

programme.title: J Music 2026 (音乐2026年)
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: Thai Rogered Sr.11 ((冲游泰国 第四辑 Sr.11))
programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, Bobo Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience. (泰国专家Hu Hu Hu Huichong再次带领Tom Yum家族成员在曼谷介绍最新的旅游信息,包括光景绝佳的按摩院、新开的天空公园购物中心、以曼谷旅游为顶峰的自助餐厅。 内容在泰国确实非常丰富。 此外,博博黄金格尔(Bobo Huang Jingling)继续出现在这一集中,给予大量福利。 她将陪同Hu Hu Huichong访问Ayutthaya、Khao Yai和曼谷的其他地区,推荐当地民众的节日旅游目的地。 除了无包装的旅馆外,他们还将参观假日相点和酒店连锁儿童游乐场,保证泰国真正的体验。)

Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! programme.desc: Liza Wang, Sammy Leung, William So, and Dickson Yu have teamed up to create a game show, inviting members of the entertainment family and guests to participate in a Werewolf Palace Edition game, revealing their foolish and clever sides. (丽萨·王、山米·梁、威廉·索和迪克森·尤合力制作一个游戏节目,邀请娱乐家庭成员和嘉宾参加狼人宫版的比赛,露出他们的愚笨和聪明的一面。客人们也会夸大真实或假故事来吸引人们的注意,以便猜测这些事件是真实的还是假的!在她与上个季节的神奇接触之后,阿洁将再次在Cheat Chat晚宴桌上提出话题。谁能带来最大的娱乐?阿洁有一大群熟人,邀请不同领域的客人,包括麦玲、南希、柳琳达、菲利普·强、亚历克斯方和钦嘉乐,参加最佳表演和慷慨奖的比赛。)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: Cantopop At 50 ((中文))
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience. (多年来,中国和国际音乐场景中都出现了无数出人意料的歌曲。 不论时代如何,每部作品都有自己的忠实粉丝。 50岁时,Cantopopo请原创歌手或有成就的唱家们重新解释这些超越世代的一度流行的经典,向音乐爱好者提供高质量的音乐娱乐。 除了在音乐产业中以有影响力的资深艺术家为主角外,这个节目还欢迎许多长期没有公开出现的歌手,给观众带来多重惊喜。)

programme.title: Woo Fung Concert 2026
programme.desc: Veteran Hong Kong entertainer Woo Fung celebrates his remarkable seven-decade career with a spectacular concert at the Hong Kong Coliseum. At 94, he performs classic songs alongside star guests including Andy Lau, Jacky Cheung and Nick Cheung. Filled with music, laughter and touching memories, the concert also marks his Guinness World Record as the oldest Chinese artist to hold a solo concert.

programme.title: J Music 2026 (音乐2026年)
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers. (Elena Kong再次领导团队,与张春龙、楚曼汉、吴宜宽和郑俊旺联合组建了Triing It Out团队,在第一季打完后以赞美和网友的热情赞美回来。 这次对台湾的新的深入探索将看到团队继续其放松、真实和自下而上的方式,引导观众深入岛屿心脏。 团队前往高盛、太南和台北,通过通过对极化的在线评论以及隐藏的宝石和鲜为人知的经验揭开有争议的商店,继续展示其精神。 团队致力于展示最真实的现场反馈,旨在创建实用的台湾旅游指南,避免观众陷入陷阱。)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2 ((女神配对计划 Sr.2))
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today ((剥茧 Whats On Today))
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case. (齐志哲(Qi Sizhe)成为黑城刑警组法医学主任,与韩峰团圆,调查其女友尤飞三年前因毒品原钻石而死亡的真相。 夜总会的一系列袭击、cocoon谋杀、医疗学校标本犯罪、保险欺诈和静默杀人都指向一个新的麻醉药品和毒品制造圈子。 齐志、韩风及其团队揭发吴永昌教授为主谋和Yu Feis真正的杀手。 警察突袭毒品工厂,逮捕吴和贩毒者,并结束新的原钻石案。)

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies (周林 他的三兄弟会)
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets. (Wong Cho-lam在一丝不苟地前往东川和尚图之后,继续其系列真实的系列风格和另一个旅行计划。然而,这一次,由朋友加入地狱,主题将是沿Cho-lams生活的里程碑进行一系列深入的重新审视,揭示日常生活的乐趣和温暖。拍摄地点横跨福州、广西和温哥华三地,这些地方在Cho-lam的生活的不同阶段对Cho-lam有着重要的意义。Cho-lam与三组旅行朋友在街道和巷子里走过,探索从家乡联系和文化觉醒到最重要的浪漫命运,通过旅行片讲述他的独特故事。)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot ((中文))
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals (了解当地习俗和文化的最佳方式是深入旅行,探索城市的每个角落,徒步旅行,探索整个城市的每个角落,欣赏沿途的风景,发现当地的生活和文化,迎接出乎意料的意外和挑战。 什乔里和蔡清春被一个制作团队引诱到台湾拍摄一个真实的节目。 从高雄机场开始,他们征服了300多公里,从太南到台北,在8天里访问了8个城市,每天只有1 000图亚,两个城市用他们的大脑解决交通和食品等问题,同时完成各种任务,甚至用有限的资源换房,他们不得不使用任何必要的手段实现其目标。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Bursting Point ((爆裂点))
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yangs rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun! (邦督察长派明警官卧底去贩毒集团以取代毒枭杨。一次失败的突袭引发杨氏复仇的愤怒。 与此同时,制毒的尹秀被迫与警方合作,并为杨设了一个陷阱。 警方和毒贩的战斗才刚刚开始!)

programme.title: Hong Kong Family ((奸人世家))
programme.desc: Eight years ago, the family in a Hakka-walled village was torn apart during a combative winter solstice dinner. Eight years later, their cousin returns home from England and seeks to reunite the family for another winter solstice dinner. While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey. (黎英在短短的工作经历之后选择退出社会。 一天,在一系列意外事件之后,她决定重新拥抱生活。 当她遇到拳击教练时,她看到了重新开始的机会,但前面的挑战远远超过她的期望,标志着她的旅程充满活力的开始。)

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques ((古董局中局))
programme.desc: Despite his familys expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life. (尽管徐元家族在古代中国遗迹中拥有丰富的经验,但徐元还是电子商场的业主,以便与他丢脸的家族保持距离。 然而,当古董被送回中国时,徐元发现了一个古老的谜题,并很快踏上一条旅程,最终可以恢复其家族的名誉,但也可能让他丧失生命。)

programme.title: Mamas Affair ((巨星养成记))
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching. (前任人才经理Mei Fung退休后留在家里照顾丈夫和儿子。 她决定重新进入娱乐行业以寻找她的生活价值,并成功地将当地一家餐厅的送餐男孩Fong Ching变成一个年轻的偶像。 这让她十几岁的儿子Jonathan非常嫉妒Fong Ching。)

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang. (这是关于香港三合会的故事。 钟·威廉·陈。 张德里克·赞和东·爱德华·楚伊是童年的朋友,他们一起加入三合会。 但是,在加入后,他们发现名声和财富最终将粉碎他们,因为他们中只有一人能够成为黑帮头目。)

programme.title: Back to the Past ((寻秦记))
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself. (帮助英正团结中国后,洪小龙在隔离中生活了20年,然而,当一群时空旅行者带着现代武器返回时,夺回秦王位,和平就破灭了。 数十年后被迫重聚,洪小龙和英正必须奋力捍卫秦王,保护历史的命运。)

programme.title: Reunion Dinner (聚会晚餐)
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity. (Chao Yang和Zi Hong很快就要结婚了,但双方都没有见到其他父母。 当客户请求为宣传其产品而提供一次同学会晚餐的活流时,这为他们父母的首次会面铺平了道路。 与母亲不同,杨决定为晚餐租个家庭,这导致一系列的不幸和分裂。)

programme.title: Life Must Go On ((The Show Must Go On（1991年皇后乐队演唱歌曲）))
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match? (当为流浪少女举办的午夜健身房项目面临资金风险时,社会工作者Yanki召集了一个躲避球队,以比赛为比赛并拯救比赛。 女孩们以前明星运动员John为教练,意识到她们必须面对自己的问题,克服挑战,而不是逃避挑战。 她们最终能够赢得比赛吗?)

programme.title: Atonement ((下一个就是你))
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Peg O My Heart ((赎梦))
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Chois past? (曼博士开始治疗夜间轮班出租车司机崔博士,他害怕睡觉,无法再将梦想与现实区分开来。 在治疗期间,曼博士被自己令人不安的、令人困惑的梦所困扰。 这些夜惊是被压抑的记忆所造成,还是被揭开Chois过去所隐藏的幽灵的代价?)

programme.title: Under Current ((内幕))
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder. (当金融总监被发现死亡,2亿港币捐款消失时,慈善晚会就变得致命。 马英凤律师和督察一起揭开洗钱和谋杀网络。)

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1 ((倚天屠龙记之九阳神功))
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sects Zhang Chui Shans son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government. (吴智(Wu Dang Sects Zhang Chui Shanss)的儿子张武智(Zhang Wu Ji)在为龙沙布雷(Dragon Sabre)而战时被无意中迷住了。 当他无意中从《吉温经记》中学习了强大的武术技能时,吴智(Wu Ji)开始帮助六大教派对抗腐败政府。)

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game. (四个戴着兔子面具的年轻盗贼把抢劫者从富人身上拉出来。 弗兰克(Frank)自称“弗兰克 ”, 他们的任务不是金钱,而是通过涂鸦和视频视频揭露腐败。 然而,当他们与参与洗钱计划的强大教会串通时,他们的任务就变成了一场致命的游戏。)

programme.title: The Sleep Curse ((乱马½))
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a young translator colluded with the enemy and was cursed by a murdered comfort woman. Forty five years later, the translators son who is a professor specializing in sleeping disorder does not believe in the sleep curse on his father and tries to dispel it with a horrifying sleep experiment. (在日本占领香港期间,一位年轻的翻译与敌人勾结,被一位被谋杀的慰安妇诅咒。 四十五年后,一位专门研究睡眠障碍的翻译儿子不相信他父亲的睡眠诅咒,并试图用可怕的睡眠实验来消除这种诅咒。)

programme.title: Beyond The Sin ((宝可梦))
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wens imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth. (严督察的唯一女儿被残忍地杀害,而她的同学温同仁也被逮捕了。 相信案件结案后,燕同仁离开警察部队。 但是,当Wen监禁后有更多的女孩被杀时,燕同仁开始怀疑真正的凶手仍然逍遥法外,并发誓寻找真相。)

programme.title: Honey Money Phony ((“骗骗”喜欢你2))
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate. (林清兰与骗子乌阳·胡伊合作,要求她收回被盗的钱.当他们建立了一个精心策划的骗子,夫妇在谎言,欺骗和命运扭曲中慢慢地对彼此产生意想不到的感觉.)

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood ((虎毒不))
programme.desc: Shu Zhens life takes a sharp downturn after the birth of her daughter. Exhausted by the demands of caring for a newborn and neglected by her indifferent husband, she finds herself caught in growing family conflicts, postnatal turmoil, and unyielding work stress. Through long and lonely nights, will the dawn bring her hope or despair? (舒申斯在女儿出生后的生活急剧下降。 被照顾新生儿的要求所拖累,被她冷漠的丈夫忽视,她发现自己陷入了日益严重的家庭冲突、产后动荡和不屈不挠的工作压力之中。 黎明会通过漫长而孤独的夜晚带来希望还是绝望?)

programme.title: Atonement ((下一个就是你))
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009 ((家有喜事2009))
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away... (成功的女商人Yu Chu没有机会找到一个有她无法忍受的个性的丈夫,这在很大程度上令她弟弟Yu Bo感到惊恐,Yu Bo由于受到诅咒,在姐姐结婚之前会失去爱。Yu Bo聘请了一位爱专家Dick去追他的妹妹。一眼就发现,Yu Chu不打算让Dick逃跑。)

programme.title: Death Stranding ((死亡搁浅))
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: One and Only ((我的唯一))
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the clubs top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing? (古老的街头舞者丁雷(Ding Lei)邀请热情的街头舞者陈秀去他的舞厅。 陈秀去他的舞厅。 当陈舞者与俱乐部顶尖舞者共舞时,斯帕克斯会飞翔。 陈追求他的梦想是为了表演,但发现丁氏邀请他是出于另一个原因。 由于他们两人都面对困难时期,他们能否扭转他们所面临的挑战?)

programme.title: Call of Heroes ((Call of 英雄es))
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland. (1914年青朝垮台后, 一群村民站在一个残酷的年轻军阀面前, 保护自己的家园。)

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman ((丹下左膳 妖刀濡れ燕))
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her. (独臂剑客方康想和妻子过平静的生活,但当她被八大恶魔剑客氏团绑架时,他被迫带着他们去救她。)

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox (狐的传说)
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father. (一位年轻人(Chin)认为他是一个孤儿,直到他遇见了三个人,并向他们学习到他的父亲是一位伟大的剑客,他的父亲在试图消除关于不法行为的谣言并将丢失的剑还给其合法主人时被杀害了。 Chin寻找男人帮助报复他父亲的不法死亡。)

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing ((茅山僵尸拳))
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts! (陈先生和他学徒的范家运送僵尸来谋生,他们被雇用一去搬9个僵尸。当2个跳跃离开时,人们发现一个人实际上是一个伪装的人,试图逃离敌人。事实证明变形僵尸和陈先生都是武术专家!)

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth ((大地儿女))
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows... (这是中日战争时期的史诗故事。 一位画家于优拯救了一位年轻女孩Lotus,Lotus,她正被卖给妓院。她们坠入爱河,结婚并安顿下来过上平静的生活。然而,他们的生活很快被日本的入侵和随后的残暴政权所摧毁。)

programme.title: The Grand Substitution ((万古流芳))
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official. (在这个歌剧史诗中,一位忠于帝国法院的仆人 放弃了自己的新生儿子 来拯救王子免遭邪恶官员的伤害)

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman ((游侠儿))
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits. (横行的剑客尤希埃(Yu Xieh Erh)掌握强大的剑法,通过抢掠盗贼和分配财富来帮助穷人。 他遇到了一群土匪,他们计划抢劫护送一些贵重物品的车队,并被骗参与抢劫。 尤伊很快就意识到他的愚蠢并返回来报复匪徒。)

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler ((玉女嬉春))
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie. (导演伊诺伊·乌梅茨古在"黄"中迎接了夜总表演者的光世界.该电影描绘了两位歌唱妹妹,清平爱琳·陈·灵和挂贝蒂·廷·佩的斗争,并在新电影中被演出时结束.)

programme.title: Brothers Five ((兄弟 Five))
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang. (5个自出生以来分离的考兄弟不知道邓龙庄主杀死了他们的父亲。 然而,所有5个兄弟都因为欺凌而发誓打败庄园里的恶棍。 在重新团结、纪律严明和辛勤工作之后,高山准备面对龙及其帮派。)

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu ((疯猴))
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult. (陈先生是一位受尊敬的子功夫大师,直到他被一个无情的恶棍入了架子和了,最终成为一个流浪艺术家.当陈在街上遇到一个年轻人,小子,他决定教他他的子功夫运动.)

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman ((楚留香之幽灵山庄))
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events. (楚留香和八世王子的阴谋是假暗杀,让楚作为卧底潜入幽灵庄园,铲除这个邪恶的巢穴。 庄园窝藏了臭名昭著的武术罪犯,并被传闻为闹鬼。 不久,在调查期间,朱楚就卷入了一系列神秘而神秘的事件。)

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee ((新陈三五娘))
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide. (黄梅歌剧情中的奇怪标题是指两个道具,表明学者和当地美女之间有一个幸福的开始.学者抛光镜子,以接近他的爱情,谁通过扔一些子来表示她的认可.从那时起,他们的爱情变得摇滚,满满谋杀和自杀.)

programme.title: House of Traps ((House of 青出于蓝s))
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house... (邪恶的王子把被盗的帝国宝藏藏在一个充满了诱杀刀片的房子里。 在等离子清除攻击中,英雄和流氓试图揭开房子的致命秘密...)

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo ((通天小子红枪客))
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Baos chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer? (青宝东亲眼目睹了恶毒的恶棍残酷杀害他的功夫大师。凶手在Baos的胸口发现一个大老鹰纹身。)

programme.title: The Fastest Sword ((天下第一剑))
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally? (南剑客丁(Southern Swordsman Ting)名为“最快之剑 ”, 但却被街头和尚打败,必须履行他的承诺,在与和尚一起渴望的石碑上工作三年。 之后,丁回到家乡过着和平的生活,并减少了所有挑战。 即使如此,他还是被迫与北剑侠作战。谁能最终获胜?)

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden ((小龙女))
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry himonly for her to refuse his proposal. (杨国和小龙国深爱并和谐地在古墓中生活。小龙国提出结婚,但杨国不结婚。她心碎,一言不发地离开。因她缺席,杨国国不知疲倦地寻找她。当他们最后团聚时,他求她嫁给他,让她拒绝求婚。)

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist ((霹雳拳))
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly. (一位恶毒的日本柔道专家想证明中国人是亚洲病态人士,并准备在危险的锦标赛中破坏和杀害最优秀的武术艺术家。 为了救他的儿子,平派拳击学会会长派他到山上学习大拳手红蝴蝶的强力雷波特拳法。)

programme.title: The Deadly Duo ((双侠))
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive. (宋朝的王子被钦族入侵者抓获,由武术大师顶尖看守。 有两个强大的爱国者需要克服巨大的困难,拉出不可能的:拯救王储并活着离开钦族据点。)

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor. (法官发现李新生儿在出生时被换换,女皇20年前驱逐她出宫殿.他让女士承认与女皇的阴谋.女皇因她的行为被定罪,李女士最终与她现在的儿子重聚.)

programme.title: The Dragon Creek ((龙虎沟))
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer. (这部Wuxia谋杀神秘片讲述了一位年轻女孩的父亲在中国早期共和时代遭到无情谋杀。 她有一张恶棍的名单,他们一直在密谋反对她的父亲,并且与她的哥哥一起,这位年轻女孩开始寻找秘密的连环杀手。)

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977 (红厅的梦想)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple. (根据同名的中国经典小说,著名的贾家族的儿子尤深深爱上了他的表弟戴尤.然而,他的母亲不赞成他们的关系,并计划安排尤嫁给另一个富裕的女孩,导致完美的夫妇的悲惨结局.)

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power ((封神劫))
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army? (唐最后一位统治者李耀耀被成朝的创始人赵国俊推翻。不幸的是,他的行动在法院和人民中引发了一场新的瘟疫,他的哥哥宽义。强奸和掠夺。随着更多的人卷入其中,它变成了血腥的背叛战场。应该由李朗这样的正直的官员来结束它。但是,一个人能接受帝国军队吗?)

programme.title: Love Parade ((璇宫艳史))
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love (时装设计师史诗请他的朋友梅美评论他的新设计,但因她的批评而愤怒。 当穆伊要求他为她设计一件礼服参加一场盛会活动时,史美通过制作小丑服装进行报复。 看到米丝尴尬,史美感到内疚,在恋爱前向她道歉。)

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother ((书剑恩仇录))
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles (皇帝强龙并非生来王位的合法继承者,但他只有在两个颠覆性反政府秘密组织的高级成员多年后与他联系时才知道真相。 诚如事实,这个组织的主管是秦龙的弟弟,他们现在必须相互对抗,扮演对立的角色。)

programme.title: Na Cha The Great ((哪吒‎))
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor. (纳查的故事是 3000 年前的.纳查为了拯救父母而牺牲了自己的生命后,他被他的精神转身在莲花中,并用两个魔术武器武装,拯救人民免受暴君的皇帝.)

programme.title: The Proud Twins ((小鱼儿与花无缺))
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother? (江晓雨在父母被谋杀后与双胞胎兄弟分离。 他被一对夫妇带到维拉斯谷,并被一群不法分子抚养长大为恶棍。 江晓雨离开山谷,在长大后探索世界。 他能为父母报仇,与双胞胎兄弟见面吗?)

programme.title: Sivalinga
programme.desc: Raheem gets killed when he tries to save a blind man in a train. When the police close the case stating suicide, Raheems girlfriend asks Shivalingeshwaran, a CID officer, to investigate the death.

programme.title: Yaman
programme.desc: After losing his father to a bunch of scheming politicians, a young man decides to wade into the corrupt and unscrupulous world of politics to avenge his death.

programme.title: Sethupathi
programme.desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.

programme.title: Theerkatharisi
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger repeatedly calls the police control room, tipping them off about impending crimes and accidents.

programme.title: Sindhubaadh
programme.desc: Thiru, a crook, falls in love with Venba and marries her before she goes to Malaysia. However, everything turns upside down when her father sells her for the skin trade.

programme.title: Andhaghaaram
programme.desc: A blind librarian, a struggling cricketer and a lonely psychiatrist find their lives entwined by fate, as unsettling events drive them toward a shared quest for retribution.

programme.title: Ko 2
programme.desc: When Kumaran, an ordinary citizen, abducts the chief minister of the state of Tamil Nadu, the whole nation wonders what could have compelled a seemingly innocent man to adopt such a drastic step.

programme.title: Kanaa
programme.desc: Kousalya, a farmers daughter, dreams of becoming an international cricketer and winning the World Cup. With her fathers support, she faces numerous challenges in her pursuit.

programme.title: Kadaisi Nodigal
programme.desc: When a serial killer goes on a murder spree, Samuel, a forensic expert, uses his skills to find evidence and uncover the killers identity.

programme.desc: Madhi helps his brother Arivu unite with the love of his life, which causes trouble between the families. When Madhi tells his parents about the woman he loves, they disapprove of his relationship.

programme.desc: SI Vetri finds severed hands in an ice cart. A fingerprint links them to his friend Amuthan, believed dead. His probe exposes a medical trial cover-up staged as accidents.

programme.desc: Whilst humans are prone to fighting the inevitability of ageing, trees have perfected the art of aging gracefully. In this episode, we will discover how mature trees do incredible things to thrive in an often turbulent world, and may even work together to do so.

programme.title: Griffs Great Kiwi Road Trip (格里夫斯伟大的基维旅行)
programme.desc: British comedian Griff Rhys Jones begin his epic off-highway journey of New Zealand from north to south, starting at Cape Reinga and travelling via Russell and Kaipara Harbour to Auckland. (英国喜剧演员Griff Rhys Jones开始了他的北到南的新西兰非高速公路旅程,从雷因加角开始,通过拉塞尔和凯帕拉港前往奥克兰.)

programme.title: Where the Wild Men Are with Ben Fogle ((Ben Fogle - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Ben Fogle travels to the forests of Chile to meet northern Brit Scott and his young family, and visit their hand-built off-grid cabin in the woods.

programme.desc: Shaquille ONeal joins Bear in the Adirondack Mountains of Upstate New York, where they deal with dense forest, leeches and steep cliffs.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild ((野生动物守护者))
programme.desc: Across Africa 97 of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away - their horns are still prized in Asian medicine. But a small, dedicated team are fighting to keep them safe. This is the frontline of conservation - it doesnt get any tougher.

programme.title: Guardians Of The Wild ((野生动物守护者))
programme.desc: Its a critical time for two black rhinos in Zambia. Four year old female Apson and fourteen year old bull Kango are at the core of a complex relocation mission thats part of a grand plan to save a species.

programme.title: Guardians Of The Wild ((野生动物守护者))
programme.desc: Deep in Kafue National Park, the largest and wildest protected area in Zambia, a team of biologists and vets from the Zambian Carnivore Programme ZCP races against time to save and protect Africas apex predators.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue ((City Wild终生惩戒 Rescue))
programme.desc: Join the rescue team for a madcap chase after a red-tailed hawk. He may be unable to fly, but he sure can run! Then follow the recovery of a rare albino squirrel who cant walk, and see how the medical team ensures hell be ready for the wild again.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends ((Amazing Animal 老友记))
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. Theyre charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitatand each other.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continents most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

programme.title: Land Of Primates ((驯荒记))
programme.desc: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungleand find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

programme.title: Colombias Wild Coast
programme.desc: Gorgona was once home to Colombias Alcatraz. Modelled on Nazi concentration camps, prisoners dreamt of escape. See the islands stunning wildlife through the eyes of a convict on the run, the monkeys, snakes and sloths whove now reclaimed the land.

programme.title: Colombias Wild Coast
programme.desc: On the island of Providencia, a black crab begins the mission of her life, escorting 80,000 eggs from her home, on a 3 km hike to the coast. Join her, and millions of her clan, on a journey fraught with danger, where chances of survival are slim.

programme.title: Wildlife ER ((Wild终生惩戒 ER))
programme.desc: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spikes leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way. (了解兽医卡里娜是否调用专家来治疗鱼脚骨折,了解鱼和鱼的胃部问题,)

programme.title: Wildlife ER ((Wild终生惩戒 ER))
programme.desc: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing. (面对大量废弃的牛排,然后和兽医护士尼克一起寻找自然疗法治疗瓦拉比的肠道病。 潘德选择了被困在树上的婴儿蝙蝠,然后看着兽医卡丽娜在谷仓猫翼上操作。)

programme.title: The Living Beach ((生动海滩))
programme.desc: Florida is famous for its sandy shoresand theres plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA. These ocean-side playgrounds are also critical habitats for threatened and endangered species. (佛罗里达以沙滩海岸闻名,有很多地方可以绕行。 佛罗里达州是美国大陆任何州最潮汐的海岸线。 这些海洋边游乐场也是濒危物种的重要栖息地。)

programme.title: The Living Beach ((生动海滩))
programme.desc: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive. (诺瓦斯科蒂亚证明,任何海都是由反对势力构建的,)

programme.title: The Living Beach ((生动海滩))
programme.desc: The Yucatn Peninsula is home to tourists, sea turtles, and sargassum seaweed. How do the three coexist in harmony? Is it sustainable? Uncover the secrets behind this Mexican beach, including an ancient birthing ritual that takes place each year.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale ((The Great 大象 Tale))
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants ((Tusker: 龙争虎斗 of Elephants))
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal. (让你与所有阶段的非洲大象,克雷格,帕斯卡尔和以扫一起深入了解鱼的复杂生活.)

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africas Wild Year ((非洲狂野之年))
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the seasons fury.

programme.title: How The Wild Things Sleep ((中文名))
programme.desc: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest. programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 五年規劃及施政報告落實北都住大啲，將45平方或以上單位的比例由百分之二十增加至百分之二十五，房屋局局長何永賢接受大鳴大放專訪時表示，注重房屋階梯上進上流，未來十年的公屋資助房屋私樓的供應比例433為基礎，建立平衡健康的置業階梯不過，外界一直建議要提升人均居住面積在這次規劃未見落墨房屋局局長何永賢指局方不以人均面積計算，而是以甲乙丙丁的戶型，她指到203132年度所有單位面積預計可增加百分之十，並有信心到2027年公屋輪候時間下降至4.5年，五年規劃列出指標，在2030年公屋輪候時間達4年以下何永賢表示注重房屋階梯上進上流，出租公屋是第一個讓基層市民有個安居之所將來有能力置業的居民交出公屋給有需要的人，房屋局興建多些居屋：我們有一個叫433的比例，出租公屋4成資助出售房屋3成私樓3成，一個平衡健康的置業階梯，還要有個流動性，一步步推進公屋輪候時間下降她又指興建大量房屋亦要提速提量，包括引進了組裝合成建築法MiC三寶現時有10條公共屋邨引用科技，智慧屋邨管理，何永賢指按公共屋邨的不同特性試行各種不同的智慧模式管理至於今年3月起按先登記後執法原則分階段推展的簡樸房制度，目前寬限期登記申請反應理想何永賢表示目前簡樸房登記已收到72880宗，佔整體11萬個分間單位的三分之二，她說比預期理想，有信心達到五年規劃列明2030年基本淘汰劣質劏房對於近期熱議有居屋單位一劏五謀取租金暴利的做法有違公營房屋原意，何永賢指若業主補足了地價是有自由在公開市場出售出租，不過，她強調該居屋一劏五是申請登記，但能否獲得認證，局方要檢視圖則，大厦公契等

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 由一個普通人，搖身一變，成為自己喜歡的動漫角色，Cosplay角色扮演，令不少人夢想成真今年八月，有化妝師與流行鼓老師組隊，代表香港出戰於日本名古屋舉行的世界Cosplay峰會，憑演繹電玩遊戲魔物獵人奪得冠軍，成為該賽事二十三年來首支奪冠的香港隊伍為了準備兩分半鐘的舞台表演，二人花了一年時間，重複修改服飾與道具，甚至由零開始自學動畫製作技術；他們希望藉著世界冠軍的榮譽，讓公眾明白Cosplay背後所需的熱誠與匠人精神，打破社會對這項活動的既有刻板印象除了競賽，亦有人將熱情轉化為事業有動漫愛好者，由自學製作道具，到遠赴台灣向電影道具師傅拜師求教，最後決定辭去閉路電視維修員的工作，全職經營Cosplay工作室他透過開班授徒，指導學員運用不同物料雕琢裝備，將興趣職業化，同時陪伴更多同好實現心中的英雄夢Cosplay亦不再是年輕人的專屬領域有社區中心舉辦樂齡Cosplay活動，吸引十八位年齡介乎四十二至七十九歲的銀髮族參與其中一位退休女士，換上神奇女俠服飾走入動漫電玩節，打破過往在寫字樓工作時文靜優雅的形象；這種身份轉換的嘗試，讓銀髮族在面對退休的心理關口時，能透過代入角色，重新尋找自我價值與面對改變的勇氣，同時亦促使不同世代之間產生理解與共鳴有專研動漫文化的學者指出，大眾往往能在眾多動漫角色中，尋找與自身產生共鳴的理想自我角色扮演者不僅是單純欣賞角色的外表，更認同並渴求學習該角色所具備的毅力或正義感等內在特質；透過親身演繹與模仿，除了能獲得同好的支持與社會迴響，滿足心理上的成就感外，亦能藉此將正向的世界觀投射到現實生活中

programme.desc: 由一個普通人，搖身一變，成為自己喜歡的動漫角色，Cosplay角色扮演，令不少人夢想成真今年八月，有化妝師與流行鼓老師組隊，代表香港出戰於日本名古屋舉行的世界Cosplay峰會，憑演繹電玩遊戲魔物獵人奪得冠軍，成為該賽事二十三年來首支奪冠的香港隊伍為了準備兩分半鐘的舞台表演，二人花了一年時間，重複修改服飾與道具，甚至由零開始自學動畫製作技術；他們希望藉著世界冠軍的榮譽，讓公眾明白Cosplay背後所需的熱誠與匠人精神，打破社會對這項活動的既有刻板印象除了競賽，亦有人將熱情轉化為事業有動漫愛好者，由自學製作道具，到遠赴台灣向電影道具師傅拜師求教，最後決定辭去閉路電視維修員的工作，全職經營Cosplay工作室他透過開班授徒，指導學員運用不同物料雕琢裝備，將興趣職業化，同時陪伴更多同好實現心中的英雄夢Cosplay亦不再是年輕人的專屬領域有社區中心舉辦樂齡Cosplay活動，吸引十八位年齡介乎四十二至七十九歲的銀髮族參與其中一位退休女士，換上神奇女俠服飾走入動漫電玩節，打破過往在寫字樓工作時文靜優雅的形象；這種身份轉換的嘗試，讓銀髮族在面對退休的心理關口時，能透過代入角色，重新尋找自我價值與面對改變的勇氣，同時亦促使不同世代之間產生理解與共鳴有專研動漫文化的學者指出，大眾往往能在眾多動漫角色中，尋找與自身產生共鳴的理想自我角色扮演者不僅是單純欣賞角色的外表，更認同並渴求學習該角色所具備的毅力或正義感等內在特質；透過親身演繹與模仿，除了能獲得同好的支持與社會迴響，滿足心理上的成就感外，亦能藉此將正向的世界觀投射到現實生活中

programme.desc: 함께 하는 대한민국을 위한 EBS 사회 공헌 프로그램

programme.title: 모여라 딩동댕
programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 로보카 폴리
programme.desc: 아름다운 섬마을 브룸스타운에는 날마다 크고 작은 사고가 끊이지 않는데... 사건이 일어날 때마다 로봇으로 변신하는 용감한 구조대, 로보카 폴리 출동!

programme.title: 어린 철학자
programme.desc: lt어린 철학자gt는 정답을 맞히는 아이가 아니라, 자신만의 생각을 가진 아이로 자라도록 돕는다. 질문하고, 사유하고, 자신의 기준을 세우고, 주장할 줄 아는 인간으로 성장하는 시간! AI 시대, 대체 불가능한 인간이 되는 가장 근본적인 힘 - 철학 하는 힘을 키운다.

programme.title: 극한직업
programme.desc: 우리 사회에는 상상을 초월하는 극도로 힘든 작업환경 속에서 일하는 사람들이 있다. 이런 극한의 직업에 종사하는 사람들의 삶을 밀착 촬영하여 생생하게 보여줌으로써 역경을 극복하고 살아가고자 하는 사람들의 숭고한 의지와 잃어가고 있는 직업정신의 가치를 되돌아본다.

programme.title: 일요시네마 lt집으로 가는 길gt
programme.desc: lt국두gt와 lt홍등gt으로 유명한 장예모 감독의 작품이다. lt집으로 가는 길gt은 최첨단 과학이 발달하고 정서가 메말라 가는 요즘 세대가 보면 답답하게 느껴질 정도로 고리타분한 정서로 사랑을 이야기하는 작품이다. 아무리 작은 것이라도 사랑하는 사람에게서 받는다면 그것은 이 세상에서 단 하나밖에 없는 물건이 된다는 작은 진리를 느끼게 해주고, 또한 개방적인 연애가 판을 치는 요즘, 보수적인 마을에서의 숨바꼭질 같은 사랑 또한 신선함을 넘어선 신기함으로 비춰진다. 무엇보다 자연을 그대로 그려놓은 듯한 아름다운 화면이 인상적이다. 영화는 흑백의 99년과 천연색 58년을 오가며 늙은 쟈오 디가 어째서 추운 겨울 직접 관을 지고 먼 길을 걷고자 하는지 일러준다. lt와호장룡gt으로 일약 스타 반열에 접어든 장쯔이의 데뷔작이기도 하다.

programme.desc: 아이의 사생활, 한반도의 공룡 등 많은 화제작과 동물, 음식, 여행 등 다양한 주제와 형식으로 남녀노소의 많은 사랑을 받고 있는 프로그램으로 시청자들의 지적욕구를 만족시켜 준다

programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 동네 한 바퀴
programme.desc: 동네 한바퀴 돌아볼 여유만 있어도 이 도시는, 삶은, 풍요로워진다. 동네아들 이만기가 걸으며 발견하고, 스토리텔러 나문희의 진정성 있는 목소리로 전하는, 아날로그 도시 기행다큐!

programme.title: 가요무대

programme.title: 생로병사의 비밀

programme.title: TV 비평 시청자 데스크

programme.title: TV쇼 진품명품

programme.title: 전국노래자랑
programme.desc: 전국 서민들의 구수한 노래를 뽑낼 수 있는 노래 자랑 쇼

programme.title: KBS 뉴스9

programme.title: 잘 살면 좋잖아
programme.desc: 잘 살면 좋잖아 평균 연령도 높아졌다는데 이제는 더 오래 건강하게 살아야 한다는데! 나이가 들수록 잘 사는 방법은 어렵다. 하지만 우리에겐 따뜻한 이웃이 있다! 아파트 반상회에서 만난 주민들과 함께 다양한 삶의 고민을 털어놓고 더 잘 살 수 있는 방법을 나눠 본다.

programme.title: 알아야산다
programme.desc: 지피지기면 백전백승 병을 알아야 병을 이길 수 있다! 1개의 병에 주원인도 여러 가지, 1개의 병에 합병증도 여러 가지, 1개의 병에 치료법도 여러 가지. 자신의 병에 있어 가장 완벽한 의사는 본인이다! 대체 병病은 왜 생겼는지? 치료를 위해 무엇을 피하고, 무엇을 바꾸고, 무엇을 먹어야 하는지? 명의들의 특강 속 퀴즈를 풀며 배워보는 알아야 산다!

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: 디어 마이 프렌즈
programme.desc: 끝나지 않았다, 살아있다. 황혼기 청춘들의 인생찬가. 어른과 노인의 차이가 대체 뭘까? 이 질문은 이 드라마의 출발점이었다. 본 드라마를 위해, 우리는 청춘들의 어른에 대한 시각을 취재했다. 그들은 가차없이 자신의 윗세대를 어른 아닌 다만 노인으로 폄하하며, 몇몇 부정적 단어로 그들을 규정지었다. 꼰대, 불편, 의무, 부담, 뻔뻔, 외면, 생색, 초라, 구질, 원망, 답답 등등. 사회적 관계에서 만나는 어른은 그렇다 쳐도 부모 조차도 가차 없었다. 말은 완곡했으나 조용히 살아주셨으면 은 공통된 견해였다. 우리는 이런 부정적 시선이 어디서 기인했나 고민했다. 청춘의 인색함일까? 역지사지 못하는 무지일까? 다만 싸가지가 없어서 일까? 우리는 청춘들의 이러한 시각이 어른들에 대한 정보의 부재, 관찰의 부재에서 온 것이라 결론지었다. 어른들이 청춘의 아픔에 갖는 무지 역시 같은 이유일 것이다. 그도 그럴 것이, 드라마 속과 언론 속 시니어는, 참으로 재수 없지 않은가. 돈에 목메고, 남의 자식 상관없고 내 자식에만 목메고, 기존의 질서에 목메고 변화를 두려워하며, 결코 사회적 문제를 약자의 편에서 사고치 않으며사회복지를 노인복지로 국한 지어 규정하는, 사유치 않으며, 젊은이를 경쟁상대로 여기거나 방해하며, 자기만 옳다고 주장하면서 나이로 권력으로 생색내는 자, 끝없이 훈계만을 늘어놓는 지혜 없는 다만 늙은 자. 본 드라마에서 우리는 노인의 이야기가 아닌 어른의 이야기를 하려 한다. 그래서, 제목처럼 청춘과 어른이 친애하는 친구가 되는 관계가 되길 바라는 마음이다.

programme.title: 짱구는 못말려 10
programme.desc: 조금은 건방지고 장난을 좋아하는 5살 유치원생 신짱구가 주인공으로, 부모님은 물론 주위의 어른들이 짱구가 일으키는 장난들에 휘말리고 마는 일상을 재미있게 그린 코믹 애니메이션. 투니버스에선 2001년 첫 방영을 시작하였으며, 현재까지도 시청자들에게 가장 큰 사랑을 받고 있는 작품 중 하나이다. 특히, 이번 lt짱구는못말려10gt은 짱구 출판 20주년, 방송 10주년을 기념하여 방영되는 시즌으로, 국내에선 한 번도 공개되지 않은 새로운 시즌이 방영될 예정이다.
